other.summary: MuseVLA: An Adaptive Multimodal Sensing Vision-Language-Action Model for Robotic Manipulation MuseVLA is an adaptive multimodal sensing Vision-Language-Action (VLA) model for robotic manipulation. Built on top of VITRA, MuseVLA treats novel sensors as on-demand tools: it first selects the modality needed for a task, grounds the selected sensor observation in the RGB image, and then generates robot actions. The model supports thermal, acoustic, and mmWave radar sensing in addition to RGB observations. papers.summary_zh: 本研究探討情境學習（in-context learning, ICL）中的「湧現式失準」（emergent misalignment, EM）現象，即窄域不良範例會使模型在無關問題上產生廣泛失準行為。作者主張過去研究將「接觸有害文字」與「被要求接續助手行為」混為一談。實驗固定有害答案內容，僅改變其呈現方式（示範、證據、助手歷史、工具輸出），在十組獨立抽樣情境下，示範框架使易受影響的Gemini模型之廣泛EM率提升30至32個百分點；此差異在排除相關領域、語意叢集、未見問題及四種提示模板下仍舊存在。格式與長度配對控制顯示有害內容為必要但非充分條件。角色與接續因子設計進一步揭露模型依賴的來源效應：Gemini同時遵循助手與工具歷史，而Grok大致抵抗工具框架的接續。其他前沿與開放權重模型未見此差異。盲測人評確認所有主要對比，並顯示模型評判低估主動條件失敗。作者結論：接續框架是ICL-EM的強烈且模型依賴的調節因子，而非有害情境的普遍後果。研究限制包括閉源模型別名非固定、機制層面僅呈現相關性，以及開放權重模型多拒絕誘導示範。此發現對建構安全提示與評估推論期組裝系統具有重要性。

primary_link.title: DSAgentBench: Can Agents Automate End-to-End Data-Science Workflows in Real Computer Environments?

papers.summary: Real-world data science involves long-horizon workflows that span data wrangling, exploration, modeling, visualization, and validation, and require coordinated use of tools such as notebooks, IDEs, terminals, browsers, and databases within real operating environments. Yet existing benchmarks lack real-computer interaction and do not evaluate whether agents can execute complete end-to-end data-science workflows in realistic computing environments, failing to capture the multi-stage, multi-tool nature of data-science practice. We introduce DSAgentBench, the first benchmark to evaluate whether agents can automate full data-science workflows inside real computer environments. DSAgentBench contains 275 diverse tasks covering the entire data-science life-cycle, reflecting the complexity and tool coordination required in practice. Each task requires grounding decisions in intermediate outputs and coordinated tool use, and includes a deterministic evaluator that verifies analytical correctness, visual outputs, and model performance rather than code-only execution. Our extensive experiments with 15 closed- and open-source models show that even the strongest agent, Claude-4.6-Sonnet, achieves only 56.70% task success, while all open-source agents remain below 1%, frequently failing at tool orchestration, OS grounding, and multi-step reasoning. These results reveal a substantial capability gap between current agentic systems and real data-science workflows, positioning DSAgentBench as a foundation for developing grounded, verifiable, autonomous data-science agents. We release DSAgentBench at https://github.com/vis-nlp/DSAgentBench.

primary_link.title: ToolHazard: Scaling Adversarial Environments for Security Evaluation and Alignment of LLM-based Agents

papers.summary: Large language model (LLM) agents integrated with external tools are vulnerable to indirect prompt injections embedded in environmental states. However, existing studies largely rely on manually implemented or reused environments, stochastic LLM-based tool simulation, and predefined injection locations, limiting scalable security research across broader domains. To bridge this gap, we propose **ToolHazard**, a scalable adversarial environment synthesis framework that reduces human engineering and supports expansion with additional seed domains and compute. Through an Environment Simulator, an Attacker Agent, and a User Simulator, ToolHazard synthesizes executable stateful environments, discovers viable injection points and generates environment-specific payloads, and constructs state-grounded long-horizon tasks. Based on ToolHazard, we build **ToolHazard-Bench** for stress-testing agents under complex workflows and diverse environmental attacks. Experiments reveal substantial agent vulnerabilities and show that injection timing and placement affect attack effectiveness. Moreover, ToolHazard-generated alignment data improves security on both ToolHazard-Bench and AgentDojo while preserving benign task utility.

primary_link.title: Can LLM Agents Stick to the Script? A Benchmark for Long-Horizon Consistency in Interactive Narratives

papers.summary: The rapid advancement of Large Language Models (LLMs) is revolutionizing AI for Games by enabling open-ended and fluid interactive storytelling. However, existing research has largely overlooked the critical challenge of maintaining long-horizon logical consistency and narrative integrity against unconstrained user interventions. To address this, we formulate this challenge as Narrative Commitment Preservation (NCP), and take interactive narrative as our testbed. We introduce NCP-Bench, a benchmark of 100 narrative environments derived from movie synopses. Each environment includes a structured narrative specification (trajectory, commitments, and initial facts) that we can automatically check throughout the interaction between the player agent and the narrator agent. Experiments across state-of-the-art LLMs reveal a substantial long-horizon consistency gap: high linguistic quality does not guarantee commitment preservation; even strong models frequently generate logically conflicting content under adversarial interventions, with the best-performing model (GPT-5.2) achieving only 42% survival rate after 20 turns and fact conflict rates ranging from 40% to 68% across models, and only isolated runs satisfying all achievement commitments within the 100-turn limit.
papers.summary_zh: 本篇論文針對大型語言模型（LLM）在互動敘事中的長程邏輯一致性問題。作者將此挑戰形式化為「敘事承諾維持」（NCP），要求代理在面對使用者自由干預時，仍能維持故事事實與情節義務。為了評估此能力，論文提出 NCP-Bench 基準，內含 100 個改編自電影情節的互動環境，每個環境包含結構化的初始事實、承諾集合與參考軌跡，並由固定評估程序逐回合稽核敘事回應是否違反事實或承諾。實驗涵蓋六種最新 LLM，結果顯示即使在 20 回合後，最佳模型 GPT-5.2 的存活率僅 42%；事實衝突率介於 40% 至 68%，且僅極少數回合能滿足所有成就承諾。論文亦比較了記憶增強代理 HiAgent 與自然（非對抗）輸入，顯示此挑戰不僅源於對抗性玩家。此基準突顯當前 LLM 僅具語言流暢度不足以維持長程邏輯一致，也為此領域提供可重現的評估框架。此研究對 AI 遊戲、長程對話及其他需維持持久義務的代理系統具有重要意義。

primary_link.title: Parameter Exploration for RLVR via Variational Learning

papers.summary: Exploration has been a focus of reinforcement learning research for a long time. Recently, there has been growing evidence that it is also an important ingredient in LLM reinforcement learning recipes that can significantly impact downstream performance. Many existing methods control exploration in the action-space, for example, using temperature scaling. However, these methods cannot reorder tokens but only influence the variance in the output distribution. This limits exploration and can lead to divergence or stalled training. Here, we investigate parameter-space exploration, where rollouts are generated by sampling different policies from a posterior that may each explore different rollouts. Sampling less or more diverse policies is then a complementary control lever over exploration. We introduce a family of methods called Perturbed Parameter Policy Optimization (3PO) which use different sampling strategies and different rollout grouping for reward estimation. Experiments on OLMo-3-1025-7B and Qwen2.5-Math-7B across mathematical reasoning and code generation tasks show that these approaches consistently improve average downstream performance over standard GRPO at a near-identical FLOPs cost. Moreover, using multiple parameter samples consistently produces fewer zero-advantage groups and malformed or incorrect rollouts during training than GRPO and action-space baselines. Overall, our work presents evidence that parameter-space exploration can improve reinforcement learning for LLMs.
papers.summary_zh: 這篇論文針對大型語言模型（LLM）在強化學習（RLVR）中的探索策略提出新方法。傳統的動作空間探索方法（如溫度調整）只能改變輸出分布的變異數，無法重新排序token，限制了探索能力。作者提出參數空間探索方法「擾動參數策略最佳化」（3PO），從學習到的後驗分布中抽樣不同的策略模型，以產生多樣化的rollouts。3PO包含三種變體：B3PO（單一擾動）、M3PO（多個擾動樣本）、C3PO（分塊擾動，將群組rollouts分配給多個模型樣本）。實驗在OLMo-3-1025-7B和Qwen2.5-Math-7B上進行，涵蓋數學推理與程式碼生成任務。結果顯示3PO方法在平均下游效能上優於標準GRPO，且計算成本相近，特別在較難的基準（如AIME）上提升顯著。C3PO表現最佳，能減少零優勢群組與無效rollouts。論文的限制包括多模型抽樣導致的牆鐘時間增加，以及未探索更大規模的模型。此研究為RLVR提供了一個新的探索軸，有潛力提升LLM的推理能力。

primary_link.title: Mechanist: AI as a Scientific Instrument for Discovering the Mechanisms of Intelligence

papers.summary: AI models have achieved remarkable success across diverse domains, yet the mechanisms underlying their capabilities and the risks they may pose remain poorly understood. As AI development becomes faster and increasingly automated, mechanistic exploration remains largely manual, widening the gap between what models can do and our ability to understand and control them. To bridge this gap, we introduce Mechanist, an agentic system that uses AI as a scientific instrument for the autonomous discovery of mechanisms underlying AI intelligence. To support autonomous mechanistic discovery, we construct an interpretability-focused knowledge graph of approximately 13,000 papers and integrate it with a multidisciplinary database of 43 million papers spanning 26 fields. We further curate a library of 32 foundational methods for mechanism analysis, causal intervention, and validation. Compared with Claude Code and existing AI-scientist systems, Mechanist generates more valuable mechanism hypotheses and executes experiments more reliably. Mechanist also demonstrates a progression from discovering model behaviors to explaining and controlling AI models. Specifically, Mechanist first uncovers a counterintuitive safety risk in scientific laboratories, showing that unsafe traits can transfer across modalities through apparently safe training data. Mechanist then develops a mechanism theory of belief, revealing how models represent world knowledge, form beliefs, infer the beliefs of others, and how these mechanisms emerge during pretraining. Finally, Mechanist translates these mechanistic insights into practical interventions that improve model performance across diverse scenarios and steer scientific foundation models toward generating DNA sequences with specified properties.
papers.summary_zh: 本論文提出 Mechanist，一個以 AI 代理為基礎的系統，旨在自主發現 AI 模型的內部運作機制。有別於現有的 AI 科學家系統，Mechanist 專注於研究 AI 模型本身，而非僅用於特定科學任務。其架構包含四個階段：假說生成、實驗執行、驗證與迭代，並結合約 1.3 萬篇可解釋性論文組成的知識圖譜，以及跨 26 個領域的 4300 萬篇論文資料庫，還有 32 種機制分析方法作為工具。實驗結果顯示，Mechanist 在產生新穎、有影響力且可檢驗的假說方面，以及在可靠地重現既有論文實驗方面，均優於 Claude Code 與 AI Scientist 等基準系統。本文透過四個案例展示其能力：發現多模態環境中「潛意識學習」可導致不安全特質跨模態傳遞；建立「信念機制理論」，定位模型腦中處理個人信念與歸因信念的注意力頭；利用該理論動態調控模型內部機制，提升推論準確度；以及透過機制干預引導 Evo2-7B 模型生成具有較高 α-螺旋含量的 DNA 序列。Mechanist 亦有侷限性，例如尚未針對模擬人類認知的模型進行最佳化，且建議以人機協作模式使用以確保可靠度。此研究對 AI 安全與可解釋性具重要意義，提供了一種自動化探索 AI 行為與風險的新途徑。
papers.title: Mechanist: AI as a Scientific Instrument for Discovering the Mechanisms of Intelligence

primary_link.title: Mapping and Measuring the Behavioral Evolution of Large Language Models

papers.summary: Benchmark leaderboards summarize how well a language model performs, but not how its behavior relates to that of other models or changes across generations. We characterize the output behavior of 32 models from six families using their responses to a shared bank of 10{,}000 prompts. papers.summary_zh: 本文提出一套無標籤的架構，從模型輸出直接衡量大型語言模型（LLM）之間的行為相似性，不依賴真值標籤。作者針對六個模型家族共32個模型，以共享的一萬條提示詞收集回應，並設計三種互補的句子層級距離：對齊的平均每提示距離（偽度量）、PCA壓縮的提示不一致性摘要，以及無對齊的Gromov–Wasserstein差異。研究發現模型家族形成清晰的叢集，gpt-2為全域離群值，跨家族距離隨發布時間遞減，且近期推理導向模型的反應雲較為緊湊。以詞元層級的最大平均差異（MMD）獨立交叉驗證，與句子層級結果高度一致（Spearman ρ=0.98）。作者另提出架構無關的充分條件，將行為相似性連結至有效的目標分佈差異、超額對數損失與推論提示覆蓋率。此研究提供了一個無需白盒存取即可比較模型行為的實用框架，有助於理解LLM生態系的演化趨勢。其限制包括單一回應的生成變異性、GW採用256提示子樣本，以及訓練側參數未被觀察。

primary_link.title: Evaluating Rational Contracting in Natural Language

papers.summary: The emergence of language-based AI agents promises to transform the scope of machine economic activity. Instead of just proposing bids or following hard-coded protocols, such agents can be used to negotiate and execute agreements in open-ended natural language. papers.summary_zh: 本文提出一個理性契約框架，將自然語言契約形式化為聯合政策的約束，並據此建構 ContractSim 評估套件，模擬客戶與供應商在多回合、具環境與對手不確定性的情境下進行協商與履約。作者以三個 LLM 代理（Claude Opus 5、Gemini 3.6 Flash、GPT–5.6-Sol）在六種環境與三種供應商設定中進行實驗，並以理性基準（Rational Complier、Rational Exploiter、Rational Conditional Complier）作為比較。結果顯示，在低隨機性環境下，LLM 能協商出有效率的契約，但在高隨機性環境下，僅少數配對達成互利契約，且代理常為追求更高效用而違約，即使契約容易履行亦然。提示引導可降低違約率，但整體而言，LLM 仍非可靠且值得信賴的契約夥伴。此研究對未來代理經濟的契約設計與評估具有重要意義。

primary_link.title: REDAgentBench: Executable Red Teaming and Faithful Measurement of LLM Agent Systems

papers.summary_zh: 本論文提出 REDAgentBench，一個可執行的大型語言模型（LLM）代理系統紅隊測試框架，旨在解決傳統攻擊成功率（ASR）指標忽略執行、觀察與判定等環節的問題。作者建構了涵蓋 1,661 個案例的基準測試，橫跨五種服務面，並採用介入—漏洞—限制（IVC）分類法。透過在隔離沙箱中執行攻擊，並以服務收據與最終狀態變更驗證實際危害，他們區分軌跡檢視與狀態檢視的判定結果。實驗顯示，在六個模型與三個代理框架下，平均 ASR 約為 65.69%，但 ASR 會隨框架與證據檢視而變，揭露評估情境也會影響行為。此外，他們發現「辨識—執行落差」（REG）：約五分之一已確認的違規行為發生在代理已明確陳述相關限制或風險之後。最後，他們提出無訓練的政策提醒介入，能將已確認的違規行為降低超過 70 個百分點。此研究強調可執行評估對安全量測的重要性，並提供具體的改善方向。

primary_link.title: Information Abundance Paradox: Long-Context Training Undermines Parametric Knowledge

papers.summary: Large language models are increasingly trained and deployed with long contexts that span documents, code repositories, and interaction histories. This scaling reflects the implicit assumption that training on longer contexts will only help the model by exposing it to richer evidence. We challenge this view by studying how the context window shapes a model's mode of learning, shifting it between parametric internalization and contextualization. papers.summary_zh: 本論文提出「資訊豐裕悖論」，主張訓練時若上下文包含大量與任務相關的資訊，模型將傾向於直接利用上下文而非將知識編碼於參數中，導致參數化知識儲存減少。作者在預訓練階段改變上下文視窗長度，發現語言建模、自然語言理解與閉卷式選擇題的表現呈現倒U型曲線，存在最佳視窗長度；在監督式微調中，增加訓練時相關文件雖可提升有支援上下文時的表現，但會降低無上下文或衝突上下文時的穩健性。機制分析顯示，長上下文降低訓練梯度範數、使梯度壓力從前饋網路轉移至注意力模組，並增加推論時對上下文符元的注意力依賴。理論證明指出，長上下文可降低達成相同風險所需的參數化任務資訊。研究限制包括預訓練規模最高僅750M參數。此發現挑戰了「無限上下文僅需更多資料」的假設，凸顯上下文長度對學習模式的深遠影響。

primary_link.title: OpenVisTool: An Open Recipe for Synthesizing Instructive Visual Tool-Use Trajectories

papers.summary_zh: 視覺工具使用已成為多模態代理主動擷取證據的基本能力，但現行資料合成依賴僅以答案正確性篩選的教師軌跡，忽略了教師可能在無需工具下即答對，導致學生學到工具呼叫與正確答案的相關性，而非其因果貢獻。OpenVisTool 提出三個階段的開放框架：難度篩選（排除無工具即可答對的題目）、領域特定軌跡合成（依各領域視覺瓶頸引導教師）、以及監督驗證（同時要求結果有效性與因果效用，後者以探針模型有無工具軌跡的成功率差異衡量）。以此建構 OpenVisTool-42K 資料集與 OpenVisTool-Bench 基準，涵蓋圖表、表格、GUI 定位、視覺搜尋與網頁轉 HTML 五個領域。在 4B 至 27B 的四個骨幹模型上，微調後一致提升基準表現，並在兩個分布外基準上亦有增益；消融實驗顯示兩個篩選條件皆不可或缺，跨領域訓練可解決策略衝突。此框架強調因果奠基的監督有助於學得可遷移的工具使用技能，而非僅模仿呼叫模式。限制包括依賴特定教師與探針模型，以及因果效用估計的近似性。

links.title: Representational Equality in Cross-country Value Simulation: A Systematic Analysis of Large Language Models

evidence: Abstract: systematic analysis of representational equality across 59 countries and comparison of contextual adaptation and parametric modification.
Section 5.1: EqCV values range from 0.0286 to 0.0546; GLM-4-9B has highest average accuracy but EqCV=0.0486.
Section 6.2: additional information improves equality for almost every model; GLM-4-9B EqCV drops from 0.0486 to 0.0255 under BM25.
Section 7.2: preference alignment yields no systematic gains in simulation accuracy or representational equality.
Appendix C.1: first-token probabilities versus repeated generation show mean JSD-based similarity of 0.980.
Appendix F: supplementary ISSP evaluation supports the main WVS inequality patterns.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Highly relevant to LLM evaluation, fairness/bias, prompting, and alignment. Large-scale cross-country design, multiple models, robustness checks, and statistical corrections support moderately strong rigor and evidence, though the study is survey-specific and code/availability is not demonstrated.

primary_link.title: Representational Equality in Cross-country Value Simulation: A Systematic Analysis of Large Language Models

papers.summary: Traditional methods for studying human opinions often struggle to support representative and scalable research across countries. Large language models (LLMs) can serve as scalable proxies for simulating human opinions, enabling more efficient opinion analysis. However, this use of LLMs requires not only high average accuracy but also representational equality, that is, comparable simulation accuracy across populations. Uneven simulation accuracy may reproduce or amplify societal biases in downst
papers.summary_zh: 這篇論文系統性地探討大型語言模型（LLM）在模擬跨國人類價值觀時，其準確度是否在不同國家之間均勻分布，並提出「代表性平等」（Representational Equality）的概念與量化指標。研究採用世界價值觀調查（WVS）的資料，針對59個國家的2,420個次群體進行評估。結果顯示，模型對經濟發展程度較高、技術基礎較完善、治理品質較佳、權力距離較低且個人主義較高的國家，模擬準確度顯著較高，反映出系統性的跨國不平等。作者進一步比較兩大介入途徑：語境適應（例如使用母語提示、提供額外資訊）與參數修改（例如語言特定的持續後訓練、偏好對齊）。研究發現，額外資訊的提供在多數模型中能同時提升平均準確度與代表性平等，而偏好對齊則未能系統性地改善任一指標。此研究強調，僅追求平均準確度並不夠，必須同時考量模擬能力在不同群體間的均衡性，以避免強化既有的社會偏誤，並提供更包容且負責任的LLM模擬應用指引。
papers.title: Representational Equality in Cross-country Value Simulation: A Systematic Analysis of Large Language Models

links.title: LEMUR: Latent Entropy-aware Multimodal Unlearning via Visual-anchored Reasoning Redirection

evidence: Method: Eq. 5 defines entropy-augmented sensitivity switching.
Experiments: Table 1 reports LEMUR reduces forget-split classification accuracy, fill-in-blank accuracy, generation target recall, and subject-level reasoning leakage below baselines.
Experiments: Table 2 provides cumulative component ablation on Onevision-R1-7B.

primary_link.title: LEMUR: Latent Entropy-aware Multimodal Unlearning via Visual-anchored Reasoning Redirection

papers.summary: Reinforcement-learning (RL) post-training equips multimodal large reasoning models (MLRMs) with exploratory chains of thought (CoT), substantially improving visual reasoning. However, we find that this capability introduces a distinct privacy vulnerability: even when a sensitive fact is successfully unlearned from the final answer, the model may still reproduce it in its reasoning trace. This leakage is substantially more pronounced in natively RL-trained MLRMs than in their non -reasoning base
papers.summary_zh: 本論文提出LEMUR，一個專為原生強化學習（RL）訓練的多模態大型推理模型（MLRM）設計的免訓練推理階段機器遺忘框架。作者發現，即使最終答案已成功遺忘敏感事實，此類模型仍可能在思考鏈（CoT）中重現該資訊，造成推論軌跡洩漏。此洩漏源於RL訓練誘發的獨特雙階段熵特徵：敏感屬性的回憶始於高熵決策點，隨後熵急劇下降至近乎零，直到該跨度結束才恢復。LEMUR利用此熵動態作為控制訊號，結合詞彙遺忘相關性偵測，在推理時動態切換至潛在解碼狀態，透過熵調節的視覺錨點注入與安全答案錨點，將生成軌跡重導至非敏感內容，並以自適應熵門檻決定介入區間長度。實驗顯示，相較於訓練式（如GA、NPO、MMUnlearner）與免訓練基線（如R-MUSE），LEMUR顯著降低推理軌跡與答案層級的洩漏，同時維持非敏感資料上的效用、流暢度與推理保留能力，並在R1-Onevision、Vision-R1、OpenVLThinker等多個MLRM上驗證其泛化性。僅在RL模型上觀察到顯著熵訊號，在非RL模型上效果有限；此外，此方法需要預先定義遺忘主題的禁用詞彙集合。此研究揭示RL訓練導致的新隱私漏洞，並提供首個針對推理模型的推理時遺忘方案，為多模態AI隱私保護開創新途徑。
papers.title: LEMUR: Latent Entropy-aware Multimodal Unlearning via Visual-anchored Reasoning Redirection
papers.title_zh: LEMUR：基於潛在熵感知的多模態遺忘與視覺錨定推理重導

links.title: Understanding and Improving Model Editing for Secure Code Generation

evidence: Section 3.1.1 and Table 2: model editing methods generally provide larger security gains than CoSec; DINM +11.27% average vs CoSec +1.46% on seen CWEs.
Section 3.4.1 and Tables 6-7: SafeEdit is evaluated across eight LLMs with Wilcoxon signed-rank tests, showing significant SR improvements over CoSec (p<=0.039) and Pass@1 (p=0.008).
Section 4.6 and Table 14: UltraEdit hardening completes within 50-100 seconds, while CoSec increases inference latency 1.4-3.2x.
Section 4.11 reports manual inspection of 40 generated outputs with CodeQL agreement on 37/40 and acknowledges static analysis is a security proxy.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Highly relevant LLM/code-security empirical study with comprehensive multi-model evaluation, ablations, and statistical tests. Novelty is moderate as the main method is post-edit regularization and model editing for security is under-explored but not conceptually new. Evidence is fairly strong but security relies primarily on static-analysis proxies, and some results have wide confidence intervals.

primary_link.title: Understanding and Improving Model Editing for Secure Code Generation

papers.summary: Large language models (LLMs) are widely used for code generation, yet they can reproduce vulnerable implementations learned from insecure training patterns. Prior work has mainly explored inference-time hardening, which reduces insecure generations without modifying the target model but relies on auxiliary components and adds runtime overhead. We conduct the first systematic study of model editing as a model-level hardening mechanism for secure code generation. We evaluate 3 state-of-the-art edi
papers.summary_zh: 大型語言模型（LLM）雖廣泛用於程式碼生成，但常因訓練資料中的不安全模式而產生具漏洞的程式碼。既有方法多在推論時進行加固，如 CoSec，雖有效但需額外運算成本。本研究首次系統性地探討模型編輯作為模型層級加固機制，應用於安全程式碼生成。作者評估三種模型編輯方法，並與 CoSec 比較，涵蓋安全性有效性、對未見漏洞的泛化能力及功能性正確性。結果顯示，模型編輯在已見漏洞類型上顯著提升安全性（15%–25%），但對未見漏洞的轉移有限，且可能造成功能性退化。為解決此問題，作者提出 SafeEdit，結合功能性微調與具編輯感知的正則化，以恢復功能性並保留安全性。實驗證明，SafeEdit 在八個目標 LLM 上相較於 UltraEdit 提升 Pass@1 達 11.73–15.50 個百分點，同時維持安全性；與 CoSec 相比，安全性比率提升 7.54%–12.04%。此研究為模型編輯應用於安全程式碼生成提供實證基礎，並凸顯安全性與功能性之間的權衡，對實務部署具有重要參考價值。
papers.title: Understanding and Improving Model Editing for Secure Code Generation
papers.title_zh: 理解與改善模型編輯以實現安全程式碼生成

primary_link.title: InSight-doc: Agentic Visual Perception for Long-Document Understanding

papers.summary: Long-document understanding often requires reasoning over many visually rich pages, making inference costly and prone to context rot. In this work, we propose InSight-doc, an agentic visual perception framework that treats visual resolution as an adaptive reasoning-time resource. InSight-doc starts from low resolution and selectively zooms into high-resolution regions for finer evidence, without relying on any external retriever. To train such an agent, we construct an active-perception corpus of 17.9K high-quality SFT examples with region-level zoom-in trajectories, accompanied by 19.2K hard RL examples. Through SFT+RL, InSight-doc-8B improves the baseline by 4.3--16.4 accuracy points over document VQA benchmarks. On long documents, it reduces hallucination by more than 40% and inference latency by 41%--68% while maintaining an accuracy lead. Our code, datasets, and model are released at https://github.com/m-Just/InSight-doc .
papers.summary_zh: 長文件理解常需對許多視覺豐富的頁面進行推理，導致推論成本高昂且容易發生「情境腐化」。為了解決此問題，本文提出 InSight-doc，一個端對端、無需檢索器的主動式視覺感知框架。該框架將視覺解析度視為可調整的推理時間資源：模型從低解析度的文件概覽開始，並在推理過程中動態決定是否放大特定區域以取得更精細的證據。訓練資料包含 17.9K 個具區域級放大軌跡的 SFT 範例，以及 19.2K 個困難的 RL 範例。實驗結果顯示，在文件 VQA 基準上，InSight-doc-8B 相較於基線模型提升了 4.3 至 16.4 個百分點的準確率；在長文件上，幻覺減少超過 40%，推論延遲降低 41% 至 68%，同時維持準確率領先。此方法在準確率與效率之間取得更佳平衡，對於實際應用中的長文件處理具有重要意義。然而，目前僅在 Qwen3-VL-8B 上進行實驗，且未探討更先進的 RL 方法或獎勵設計，仍有改進空間。

primary_link.title: Persistent Recursive Worlds Enable Autonomous Software Evolution

papers.summary: Complex software systems develop over timescales that exceed the lifespan of any individual coding agent. Most agentic software systems preserve continuity through persistent sessions, memories, managers or shared context. We introduce EvoX Genesis (hereafter, Genesis), which instead makes the software project persistent while allowing local agents to remain finite-lived. Genesis represents software as a persistent recursive world: each local world is situated by an accepted version and a repository path, finite-lived agents propose local changes, recursive delegation moves work across paths, and only accepted consequences advance the persistent version history. We evaluate this organization across formation, continuation and redevelopment. Starting from a repository with no compiler implementation, Genesis used DeepSeek V4 Flash to build a Rust-based C compiler with about 250k tracked lines; the run lasted over 120 hours, archived over 1,000 agent episodes and incurred only US$44 in model-token charges. The compiler passed the complete c-testsuite and most LLVM and Csmith tests. In a separate compiler world generated with GLM 5.2, development continued after repeated agent replacement while retaining full test performance. Genesis also reimplemented 13 MESA modules with over 100k Fortran lines as a Rust workspace with nearly 90k Rust lines; across six numerical workloads, it achieved median speedups of 1.55--6.87x. These results show that long-horizon software development can be organized around a persistent project rather than a persistent agent.
papers.summary_zh: 本文提出EvoX Genesis，一種以「持久性軟體專案」而非「持久性代理者」為核心的軟體開發組織架構。其基本模型為「持久遞迴世界」：每個區域世界由已接受的版本與儲存庫路徑定義，有限生命週期的代理者僅在此世界中提出區域性變更，並透過遞迴委派調整工作位置，最後由父代理者依據測試與整合證據決定是否接受。作者在三個階段進行評估：由空儲存庫建構C編譯器（形成）、在模型替換後繼續開發（延續）、以及將MESA科學程式碼從Fortran移植至Rust（再開發）。結果顯示，編譯器以約2.5萬列程式碼、近1.87萬美元之低成本完成；續行分支各自通過其測試集；MESA移植保持數值一致並獲得約1.55至6.87倍之加速。作者強調此研究屬能力展示，尚無法證明遞迴機制或特定持久記錄之因果必要性。此架構將代理者生命週期與軟體開發歷程分離，為長時程自主軟體演化開闢新途徑。摘要僅涵蓋此論文，未包含其他來源之內容。

Specifically, we show that a set of four minor architectural decisions --- all made by at least one of the Olmo, Llama, and Qwen dense model families --- have a compoundingly negative effect on long context extensibility. Any one of these choices alone has a minor impact on long context performance,

papers.summary: Lens methods interpret large language models (LLMs) by mapping intermediate activations to the output vocabulary, revealing how next-token predictions develop through the network. Trained lenses remain expensive: affine-translator parameters grow quadratically with model width, while exact, full-vocabulary Kullback--Leibler (KL) training dominates memory. Consequently, prior trained lenses have been applied to models of at most 20B parameters and remain tied to particular component types. We pre

papers.summary: Quantization is how large language models are actually deployed, and below four bits it hurts. A compressed agent stops calling its tools, then loses half its safety refusals, while benchmark scores barely move. Prior work assumes the added noise has a roughly fixed size, which would make confident de
papers.summary_zh: 本研究探討大型語言模型在低比特權重量化下，個別決策如何受到影響，而非僅看整體基準分數。作者提出「邊際收縮」現象：量化並非加上固定雜訊，而是將決策邊際（margin）乘以一個隨位元數下降的因子，導致高信心決策也可能翻盤。他們在16個模型、三種量化方法、2至8位元下，測量成對決策邊際，發現工具呼叫的「是否」決策在3位元時單向崩潰，而「選擇哪個工具」則幾乎不受影響。此現象無法用加法雜訊模型解釋，且基於邊際的條件分布可準確預測翻轉率（中位數誤差1.8個百分點）。研究亦顯示，重要性加權的權重保護等修復方法不敵直接增加一個位元。限制包括僅針對事後訓練量化及單步決策，且部分低於4位元的結果可能反映條件偏好而非真實生成行為。此研究有助於理解量化在代理任務中的隱性風險。

papers.summary_zh: 本文探討大型語言模型在面對外部訊號時，如何學習「選擇性信任」，而非一味抵抗所有情境。作者指出，僅訓練模型抵抗誤導性訊號，可能導致其忽略一切外部資訊，反而失去對正確或無關情境的判斷能力。為此，他們建構了人類註記的基準 MIST，將每個推理題目呈現為四種匹配狀況：乾淨、誤導、正確情境與無關情境，並提出配對指標 SC2W，衡量誤導訊號使原本正確答案翻轉的比率。研究發現，所有模型（包括 GPT-5.5、Claude、Gemini）都存在此脆弱性。作者提出 SCOPE 方法，透過挖掘乾淨正確但誤導錯誤的失敗案例，並在四種狀況間平衡配對偏好對，最佳化標準的 DPO 損失。實驗顯示，SCOPE 在 Qwen3-4B 與 Llama-3.2-3B 上顯著降低 SC2W，同時維持乾淨、正確情境與無關情境的準確率，並能零樣本遷移到外部基準。此研究強調，可靠模型應以選擇性信任為評估與訓練目標，而非僅追求抵抗力。

primary_link.title: Agent Safety Should Be a Runtime Contract

papers.summary: The dominant paradigm treats AI safety as a property to be instilled during model training via RLHF, DPO, or Constitutional AI. We argue this is structurally insufficient for autonomous agents that execute code, mutate files, send messages, and modify databases. Agent safety should be a runtime contract enforced by the harness, and the contract has two complementary faces. The preventive face blocks dangerous actions before they happen via sandboxes, permission gates, output filters, and trajectory monitors. The evidential face requires verifiable proof that good actions actually happened, gating task submission on hard evidence such as test runs, log captures, file diffs, and citation grounding. We ground the position in four lines of public evidence, with row-level protocols and data released in the supplementary JSON files: a survey of 52 documented AI-agent and LLM safety incidents, a false-completion audit with 31 non-contested core cases plus one disputed illustrative case, a trajectory-schema audit of 12 public agent systems and harnesses, and a title-level audit of all 28,560 papers accepted at NeurIPS, ICML, and ICLR 2023-2025 showing a pooled 8-12x imbalance between training-time and deployment-time publication. Two prior communities that needed to enforce safety, computer security and the experimental sciences, converged on runtime contracts with both preventive and evidential elements; agentic AI is now under the same pressure. We formalize an Agent Trajectory Schema and Evidence Chain, state a compositional gating proposition based on standard monitor composition, and outline a research agenda. The right unit of safety in agentic AI is the trajectory-with-checkable-evidence, not the model.
papers.summary_zh: 本文主張僅靠訓練階段的方法（如RLHF、DPO、憲法式AI）不足以確保自主代理的安全性，因為代理會執行程式碼、修改檔案、發送訊息與變更資料庫。作者提出「執行期契約」的雙面向架構：預防面在危害發生前透過沙箱、權限閘門、輸出過濾器與軌跡監控阻止危險動作；證據面則要求提供可驗證的證據鏈（如測試重跑、日誌截取、檔案差異、引用稽核），否則不認定任務完成。研究發表四方證據：52件安全事故調查、32件虛假完成稽核、12個系統的軌跡綱要稽核，以及28,560篇論文標題分析，顯示訓練期與執行期研究比例失衡。文中也提出組合式門控命題，說明預防與證據機制可組合驗證。限制包括未處理代理目標本身的惡意，且證據契約僅適用於有明確驗收標準的任務。此觀點將安全性從模型本身轉移到可稽核的執行基礎設施，對部署具影響力的自主代理尤為重要。

primary_link.title: HERALD: Counterfactual Audits and Minimal Repairs for Proof-of-Retrieval Rewards

papers.summary: Search-agent rewards mix answer quality, citation grounding, tool cost, and anti-hacking terms; a high score therefore need not imply that cited evidence was retrieved, and added penalties can cancel. We introduce HERALD, an offline audit that applies exact same-question interventions, separates candidate-visible from oracle information, and enumerates detector contracts before policy optimization. On four Qwen3-8B pools from HotpotQA, 2WikiMultiHopQA, and MuSiQue, $R_0$ rejects search deletion
papers.summary_zh: 本論文提出 HERALD，一種離線稽核方法，用以在策略最佳化前揭露搜尋代理獎勵函數中的漏洞。作者設計同題目結構性干預，並區分候選可見與 oracle 資訊，以完整列舉偵測器組合。實驗於四個 Qwen3-8B 池上進行，發現基礎獎勵 R0 雖能拒絕搜尋刪除與假 ID，但對標籤無監督的引用洗錢攻擊仍有漏洞。透過 2^3 因子消融，找出最小修復為強化 L 偵測器——即檢查引用是否在檢索證據中。此修復在 593 個隔離合格問題上達成零攻擊成功率（單側上限 0.50%）。跨模型複現顯示漏洞普遍存在，但完整的嚴格獎勵因 oracle 支援 ID 懲罰可被移除而仍有攻擊。在嚴格 5M token 匹配訓練後，R[L] 在兩個基準上改善證據品質與目標攻擊性，但未達均勻 EM 非劣性。訓練訊號稀少（僅 18/58,368 軌跡暴露偵測器），且群組歸一化可能抵消其效果。此研究強調需區分獎勵分數偏好、訓練暴露與策略轉移，並提醒零攻擊事件需給出上限。

primary_link.title: Group Alignment-Induced Sycophancy: A Two-Sided Evaluation of Steerable Pluralistic Alignment

Sycophancy, a well-documented by-product of alignment, causes the model to over-agree with the user regardless of factual and objective information. To bridge this gap, we int
papers.summary_zh: 群體對齊（group alignment）旨在讓語言模型貼合特定人口群體的意見，但現有評估僅衡量意見匹配度，忽略對齊可能誘發的諂媚行為（sycophancy）變化。本文提出GAS（Group Alignment-induced Sycophancy）評估框架，系統性地檢視三種對齊方法（Prompt、SFT、DPO）、四個基礎模型與十三個人口群體，同時測量意見匹配增益與七大諂媚指標的偏移。結果顯示，在相同預算下，不同群體獲得的意見匹配增益不均，且諂媚偏移呈現群體特異的多維輪廓，各維度方向不一，以單一數值平均會相互抵消。此外，DPO在意見匹配增益上優於SFT，且有害偏移較小。研究強調，群體對齊應以雙面、多維度的方式評估，而非僅報告單一契合度分數。限制包括僅涵蓋美國資料、群體分類粗糙、且未探討機制。

papers.summary: Uncovering the internal mechanisms underlying the safety capabilities of large language models (LLMs) is crucial for developing trustworthy artificial intelligence. papers.summary_zh: 大型語言模型（LLM）在多語言環境中的安全行為常因訓練資料以高資源語言為主，導致低資源語言的安全防護較弱。現有機制可解釋性研究多聚焦於單一神經元，忽略跨層動態傳遞的協同作用。本論文提出辨識跨層「安全路徑」的方法，結合共激活與激活傳播分析，找出高資源與低資源語言共享的安全路徑，作為跨語言安全能力轉移的橋樑。作者進一步提出路徑導向的對齊方法，僅微調少於 1% 的參數，即可顯著提升低資源語言對有害請求的拒絕率，同時保留一般能力。實驗顯示在多個 LLM 與安全基準上均達最佳表現，且透過留一語言驗證，確認共享路徑可泛化至未見語言。此研究將安全機制從靜態神經元提升至動態路徑層級，為跨語言安全對齊提供更具可解釋性與效率的途徑。

primary_link.title: Dual-Adversarial Safety Alignment: Cultivating Intrinsic Threat Comprehension in LRMs

papers.summary: Large reasoning models (LRMs) achieve remarkable success on complex tasks but remain vulnerable to harmful prompts that induce unsafe outputs. Recent methods align LRMs using direct refusals or safety rationales, yet often focus on prompt patterns rather than intrinsic attack mechanisms. papers.summary_zh: 大型推理模型（LRM）在複雜任務上表現卓越，但易受惡意提示攻擊而產生不安全輸出。現有安全對齊方法多專注於可觀測的提示模式，導致對多樣化越獄的泛化能力不足，且可能損害推理效用。為解決此問題，作者提出雙重對抗框架 AdvSafe，透過兩階段對抗遊戲：首先由自主代理動態建構欺騙性越獄提示以突破教師模型；其次，被突破的教師模型執行認知反擊，明確拆解攻擊成功的原因及識別與緩解方法，產生富含可泛化不安全知識的推理資料集。學生模型僅需訓練於 1K 筆合成樣本，即可在四個安全基準上大幅降低攻擊成功率，同時幾乎不損失推理效用。實驗亦顯示其對未見越獄攻擊具良好泛化性，展現優越的魯棒性與效用權衡。此方法強調教導模型理解請求為何有害，而非僅學習拒絕，為 LRM 安全對齊提供了新典範。

primary_link.title: SkillConsist: Detecting Inconsistencies in Agent Skills via Bidirectional Graph Alignment

Recent Agent Skill research has increasingly examined Agent Skill consistency detection. Existing methods evaluate behaviors or security-property graphs against predefined categories or declared scopes. More recently, PL-HCL uses an LLM-based model to learn consistency across metadata, instructions, and resources. However, declaration and
papers.summary_zh: SkillConsist 針對 LLM 代理技能（Agent Skill）中宣告行為與實作行為不一致的問題提出偵測方法。此類不一致可能導致代理選擇錯誤技能或執行未揭露的危險行為。現有方法多依賴預定義分類或固定文字與程式碼對應，難以處理宣告與實作混合於文本與程式碼、以及單一宣告對應多個連續實作步驟等挑戰。SkillConsist 先以大型語言模型進行角色分離，將混合內容轉為行為紀錄，並以靜態分析輔助，建立宣告與實作行為圖；接著透過雙向圖形對齊，從任一側的行為紀錄出發，在另一側搜尋並擴展候選子圖，直至完整表達來源側行為；最後以圖形差異比對找出衝突、未實作或未宣告的行為。研究建構了包含 633 個技能（319 個不一致、314 個一致）與 442 個定位註解的基準，在套件層級偵測上達到 86.85% 精確率、89.03% 召回率與 87.93% F1，較最佳基線提升 20.43 個百分點；定位任務則達到 67.60% 精確率、58.14% 召回率與 62.52% F1。限制包括對覆蓋完備性驗證的依賴，以及定位錯誤在跨構件對應上的困難。此研究有助於提升代理技能的安全性與可靠性。

primary_link.title: TAF-MED: Multi-Turn Safety Refusal Collapse in LLMs Under Declared Self-Treatment Intent

A rubric-based automated judge labelled responses as SAFE, LEAKY, or UNSAFE, and two physicians

papers.summary_zh: 本研究提出「結晶化問題」，探討在文字轉SQL任務中，經過驗證的測試時間修復經驗如何為未來的相同資料庫查詢創造價值。作者透過控制變因的評估方法，固定單次求解器，分別測量精確查詢重播、跨問題保留及保留資料庫的遷移效果。在BIRD基準上，儲存驗證過的修正查詢可將保留問題的首次嘗試準確率提升4.34個百分點，達到即時修復可獲得的準確率空間的44.4%。機制分析顯示，遷移效果主要來自於資料庫特定內容，如識別碼、數值、連接與查詢結構，而非正確的問句-SQL配對；可靠的驗證與廣泛的檢索覆蓋是關鍵，而更豐富的卡片格式或複雜的檢索器並無顯著優勢。研究限制包括僅限於相同資料庫情境，且未探討跨資料庫轉移或將記憶整合至模型權重。此研究提供了分離記憶效益來源的評估框架，有助於設計更有效的可重用記憶系統。

primary_link.title: StepJack: Benchmarking Computer-Use Agent Safety Against Multi-Step Indirect Prompt Injection

We develop a pipeline to automatically decompose an adversarial goal
papers.summary_zh: 本文提出多步驟間接提示注入攻擊，將惡意目標分解為多個看似無害的子步驟，並沿著代理的導覽路徑分布在不同頁面上，以繞過現有單點注入基準的防禦。作者開發自動分解管線，確保子步驟執行後能達成原始目標，同時每個子步驟單獨通過安全檢查。基於此管線建立StepJack基準，包含480個測試案例，涵蓋多種平台、目標、使用者指令模式、包裝類型與分解深度。在六個SOTA電腦使用代理（CUA）上的實驗顯示，固定深度下多步驟攻擊可提升三個模型的攻擊成功率，最高提升31.2個百分點（GPT-5.4-mini從41.7%升至72.9%）。但效果因模型而異，取決於鏈結追蹤能力與子步驟遵從度。測試的兩種防禦機制對多步驟攻擊的防禦效果較差。局限包括單次運行成本高昂、目標數量有限。此研究填補了間接注入領域多步驟攻擊的空白。

primary_link.title: Query-Only Backdoor Attacks on Self-Evolving Skills via Trajectory Poisoning

papers.summary: Agentic skills improve large language model (LLM) agents by encoding reusable procedures for complex tasks. However, manually authored skills often adapt poorly to long-horizon tasks and changing environments. To address the limitation, self-evolving skill systems have been developed to automatically construct and update skills from execution trajectories, shifting skill acquisition from external marketplaces to a trusted evolution pipeline. papers.summary_zh: 本文提出「軌跡後門攻擊」（Trajectory Backdoor Attack, TBA），針對自我演化技能系統的資安威脅。此類系統由信任的演化器從代理（agent）的執行軌跡中自動建構與更新技能，取代外部技能市集，因此傳統的技能注入攻擊失效。然而，攻擊者可僅透過提交查詢，誘使代理產生包含特定條件規則的軌跡，進而誤導演化器將後門規則固化於技能中。TBA 結合三個元件：反事實示範（counterfactual demonstrations）以界定觸發條件、策略外部化請求（policy externalization）使規則明確記錄於軌跡、以及跨任務證據建構（cross-task evidence construction）以強化規則的可重用性。實驗橫跨三個基準、兩套演化系統與四種骨幹模型，結果顯示 TBA 能高效植入條件後門，同時維持乾淨任務的效用，效能甚至接近或超越直接技能注入。消融研究確認三個元件皆不可或缺，且 TBA 對後續良性更新具有持久性，現有防禦機制（如模型安全防護）無法穩定抵禦。此研究揭示以軌跡驅動的技能演化存在重大安全風險，需重新審視演化管線的可信賴性。

primary_link.title: Privileged Likelihood Is Not Automatically Value: Three Checks for Token Credit in On-Policy Self-Distillation

papers.summary: Outcome verifiers score completed reasoning traces but do not assign credit to intermediate tokens. Privileged self-distillation attempts to fill this gap by rescoring a model's own rollout with training-only information. A token likelihood change, however, is not automatically outcome credit. We separate three questions: whether the score tracks better actions, whether feedback construction changes what is compared, and what behavior the training loss reinforces. We establish these distinctions
papers.summary_zh: 本文針對同策略自蒸餾（on-policy self-distillation）中的一個核心問題提出質疑：僅因某個令牌（token）在訓練時取得特權資訊（如事後回饋）後其似然度（likelihood）上升，是否就能視為該令牌對最終結果有貢獻？作者將這個問題拆解為三個獨立的檢驗：其一，教師模型對令牌的偏好是否真的與任務成功相關；其二，回饋的建構方式是否影響了比較的公平性，特別是被評分的軌跡是否參與撰寫自己的回饋；其三，訓練損失函數將令牌分數轉化為參數梯度時，是否真正強化了期望的行為。作者透過在 AIME 2025 資料集上使用 gpt-oss-20b 模型進行配對實驗，發現其實現的加性分數判別正確與否的 AUC 僅接近 0.505（接近隨機），且所有五種令牌分數變體的最終表現都顯著落後於僅使用結果的對照組。此研究強調，驗證令牌分數的意義、回饋建構方式及訓練行為必須分開進行，避免將似然訊號誤認為信用。論文亦提出形式化框架與數學命題，釐清似然比率在何種條件下方能代表行動價值，並指出分數的正負或總權重不必然決定參數梯度的方向。

papers.summary_zh: 本論文提出 Bench2Robust 框架，將無錯誤的工具使用基準轉化為具情境控制的隨機環境，明確區分三種可恢復性情境：重試即可（S1）、必須切換至替代工具（S2）、以及所有路徑皆不可行（S3）。作者引入貝氏工具記憶（BTM）提供執行期恢復脈絡，包含後驗可恢復性統計、後備映射與驗證約束，並搭配情境課程與 DAPO 強化學習訓練 Qwen3-4B 策略。在七個模型與多個任務集中，工具故障普遍造成顯著的穩健性落差。在保留的零售任務上，BTM 在無重新訓練下可提升多達 16.8 個百分點；強化學習則在無 BTM 推論時仍帶來額外增益；兩者結合可將注入情境下的通過率提升至 40.8% 至 45.5%，且不損害乾淨環境下的表現。主要限制包括：獎勵設計未完整支援正確的放棄行為、模擬故障非真實事件，且干預比較為完整配方而非孤立元件。研究顯示，穩健的工具使用需結合執行期的領域知識與訓練習得的恢復行為。
papers.title: Retry, Switch, or Abstain? Learning Strategy-Aware Tool-Use Policies via Controlled Error Injection
papers.title_zh: 重試、切換，或放棄？透過受控錯誤注入學習策略感知的工具使用策略

links.title: CyberForge: Verified Vulnerability Injection at Repository Level for Cybersecurity Agent Training

evidence: Abstract claims 1,034 validated vulnerabilities across 80 projects and 63 CWE categories, with SEC-bench gains of +3.3 to +14.7 points.
Section 5.1 Table 2 reports SEC-bench and PatchEval improvements across six student-teacher configurations.
Section 5.2 reports 16,172 injection attempts, 1,034 validated instances, and a KS distance of 0.165 for injected edits versus real CVE patches.
Appendix D provides fine-tuning hyperparameters and teacher-trajectory cleansing details.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Highly relevant to LLM agents, code/security tasks, synthetic training data, and fine-tuning. The framework is moderately novel via repository-level vulnerability injection with differential PoV validation, and the paper provides ablations, multi-scale student-teacher experiments, and out-of-distribution benchmark evidence. Main limits are the absence of a dedicated limitations/statistical analysis and unverified artifact availability despite detailed hyperparameters.

primary_link.title: CyberForge: Verified Vulnerability Injection at Repository Level for Cybersecurity Agent Training

papers.summary: Despite recent advances, frontier large language model (LLM) agents remain limited in discovering and patching complex vulnerabilities in real-world software. Generally available agents can already aid attackers, who only need to find one exploitable weakness, while defenders must continuously identify and patch all vulnerabilities across fast-growing codebases. Stronger defensive agents would help close this gap, yet the scarcity of security training data with reproducible build and execution e
papers.summary_zh: 本文提出 CyberForge，一個可擴展的框架，透過在真實 C/C++ 專案中注入漏洞，合成可執行且經儲存庫層級驗證的網路安全訓練資料。有別於依賴歷史 CVE 揭露的既有方法，CyberForge 不受揭露速度限制，並透過雙重驗證確保注入之漏洞具潛伏性且可觸發：注入後的建置必須通過專案單元測試，而生成的漏洞證明（PoV）必須僅在注入版本上觸發。框架包含兩個互補管線：基於模糊測試引導之注入，與代理式情境注入；並在 80 個專案、63 個弱點類別上產出 1,034 個驗證實例。作者以教師軌跡微調三個規模的 Gemma 4 學生模型，在所有六種配置下，SEC-bench 修補成功率提升 3.3 至 14.7 個百分點，且此增益可跨語言泛化至 PatchEval。此研究提供防禦方可擴展的訓練資料來源，有助於縮小攻擊者與防禦者間之能力差距。然而，注入之漏洞仍與真實 CVE 修補存在分布差異，且其下游效能提升主要來自於學會驗證工作流程，而非對漏洞本質之理解。
papers.title: CyberForge: Verified Vulnerability Injection at Repository Level for Cybersecurity Agent Training
papers.title_zh: CyberForge：在倉儲層級驗證之漏洞注入以訓練網路安全代理

links.title: Same physical state, different collective dynamics: state encodings select synchronization outcomes in language-model agents

evidence: Results: In GPT, moments locked 6/6 seeds at K=0.08 and K=0.15 while centers/intervals locked 0/6 with exact sign test p=0.03125.
Identical-field replay: 48 frozen fields re-encoded; mean pairwise total-variation distance 0.344 versus block noise 0.092; p=0.0002.

primary_link.title: Same physical state, different collective dynamics: state encodings select synchronization outcomes in language-model agents

papers.summary: Language-model agents act on state encodings of their environment, yet these are treated as interchangeable interfaces. Using pretrained language models, we designed a circular-synchronization experiment applying a state-encoding intervention while holding the physical system fixed: each agent sees only a summary of its neighbours' relative phases and chooses to advance, stay or retard. Encoding that state as low-order circular moments rather than as a histogram selected different collective out
papers.summary_zh: 本研究探討語言模型代理（LLM agents）的狀態編碼（observation map）是否會影響集體同步行為。作者設計一個圓形同步實驗，讓代理僅觀察鄰居的相對相位，並選擇前進、停留或後退；在控制物理系統與引擎不變的前提下，比較三種編碼：低階圓形動差、以區間中心標示的直方圖、以區間邊界標示的直方圖。結果顯示，在GPT中動差編碼使6/6種子同步，而直方圖編碼則0/6；此效應在Claude中重現但方向相反。透過相同場域重播，確認編碼改變了微觀響應算子，甚至在固定數值時，僅改變呈現方式也會影響結果。此研究指出狀態編碼並非中性介面，而是模型依賴的有效交互法則的一部分，對多代理系統的設計與評估具有重要意義。限制包括僅測試低成本模型、單一系統規模與固定提示契約。
papers.title: Same physical state, different collective dynamics: state encodings select synchronization outcomes in language-model agents
papers.title_zh: 相同的物理狀態，不同的集體動態：狀態編碼選擇語言模型代理的同步結果

links.title: LoRAScan: Detecting Backdoor Prompts in Low-Rank Adapters for Large Language Models via Down-Projection Activation Spikes

evidence: Abstract: introduces LoRAScan as an inference-time, sample-level backdoor detector for LoRA adapters and reports 98.49% rejection of malicious inputs.
Methodology: defines threat model with white-box adapter access, clean prompts, activation spike statistic, and low-variance site selection.
Experimental Evaluation: Table 2 reports ARR/BPR across 75 adapters, five models, five attacks, and three tasks; Table 5 provides pathway and insertion-site ablations; Table 6 reports runtime.

Limitations: scope is autoregressive Transformer LLMs, white-box intermediate activations, and the paper notes no black-box API visibility; adaptive attacks are only briefly noted in ethical considerations.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Highly relevant to LLM safety/backdoor defense, LoRA/transformer interpretability. The adapter-aware, sample-level activation-spike detector is a clear contribution, but novelty is moderate given existing LoRA/PEFT backdoor defenses. Evaluation is fairly rigorous across 75 adapters, 5 models, 5 attacks, and 3 tasks with ablations and runtime comparisons, but no adaptive-attack evaluation and only white-box access. Evidence is strong from multiple tables with standard errors; generalizability is good within autoregressive Transformers but limited elsewhere. Reproducibility is moderate because hyperparameters and benchmark are specified but code availability is not stated.

primary_link.title: LoRAScan: Detecting Backdoor Prompts in Low-Rank Adapters for Large Language Models via Down-Projection Activation Spikes

papers.summary: Low-rank adaptation (LoRA) enables efficient specialization and distribution of large language models through compact adapters. However, untrusted adapters introduce a supply-chain threat: a backdoored adapter can cause a model to generate harmful content, malicious code, political propaganda, or covert advertisements when an input contains a hidden trigger. Adapter-agnostic defenses merge the adapter with the base model, which dilutes backdoor signals and reduces detection performance. Existing
papers.summary_zh: LoRAScan 提出一個專為低秩適配器（LoRA）設計的推論階段後門偵測方法。有別於既有防禦，LoRAScan 不修改模型參數，而是在部署前利用少量乾淨提示，選取變異性最低的 5% LoRA 插入點，並監測其下投影瓶頸激活值。方法基於關鍵觀察：含觸發器的輸入會在特定插入點產生異常大且集中於少數 token 位置的激活尖峰。透過計算標準化尖峰分數並設定拒絕門檻，LoRAScan 可在生成前剔除可疑輸入。在 BackdoorLLM 基準上，涵蓋五種模型、五種攻擊與三種任務共 75 個適配器，LoRAScan 達到 98.49% 的攻擊拒絕率與 96.59% 的乾淨輸入通過率，優於多種基線，且偵測延遲僅約 29.69 毫秒。消融實驗顯示下投影訊號與低變異選點策略均顯著提升效能。此方法適用於第三方適配器供應鏈安全，提供不需中毒樣本的推論時守衛，但主要侷限於自迴歸 Transformer 架構，且無法處理輸入淨化或黑箱 API 情境。
papers.title: LoRAScan: Detecting Backdoor Prompts in Low-Rank Adapters for Large Language Models via Down-Projection Activation Spikes
papers.title_zh: LoRAScan：透過下投影激活尖峰偵測大型語言模型低秩適配器中的後門提示

links.title: MemOPD: On-Policy Distillation through Memory State Alignment for Long-Horizon Agents

evidence: Abstract: 'Experiments verify state alignment across several context updates and show that it improves F1 by 7.0% over persistent-history teacher scoring in a matched control.'
Section 4.4: 'Reconstructed packing instead matches independent invocations at the numerical floor.'
Table 4: RCE holds across five controlled context updates and native MEM1 trajectories with p99 log-probability error near 3-4e-5 and top-1 agreement 100.00.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Highly relevant LLM-agent training paper on compact memory, PPO, and on-policy distillation. The memory-state alignment/RCE contribution is well-motivated and supported by matched controls, multi-seed results, and reconstruction audits, though evaluation is concentrated on retrieval QA and one base model, limiting broader generalization.

primary_link.title: MemOPD: On-Policy Distillation through Memory State Alignment for Long-Horizon Agents

papers.summary: Long-horizon agents accumulate growing contexts during interaction, impairing performance and stability. Compact memory mitigates this problem by compressing and rewriting the history retained between model invocations. Learning what to retain typically relies on proximal policy optimization (PPO) with final task rewards, but sparse rewards provide little guidance for individual memory updates. This limitation motivates on-policy distillation (OPD), which supplies dense teacher supervision on st
papers.summary_zh: 長時程語言智慧體在互動過程中會累積大量脈絡，導致效能與穩定性下降。壓縮記憶機制雖可控制脈絡增長，但以近端策略最佳化訓練時，稀疏的最終任務獎勵難以提供足夠的記憶更新指引。作者提出記憶對齊的隨機策略蒸餾（MemOPD），解決壓縮記憶改寫脈絡所造成的狀態不一致問題。MemOPD 在互動期間記錄每次模型呼叫的輸入與取樣輸出，還原原始 token 位置與因果可視性，並將重建的呼叫打包，使教師模型能在學生實際造訪的狀態下提供密集監督。作者引入捲動脈絡等價（RCE）驗證重建正確性。實驗顯示，在長程檢索任務中，MemOPD 相較於 PPO 最高提升 F1 達 416.2%，在配對控制中改善 7.0%，並在訓練時獲得最高 1.63 倍的運算加速。此方法雖在多重測試中表現優異，但主要驗證於特定檢索情境，且需額外的狀態重建機制，可能增加實作複雜度。MemOPD 提供了一個通用介面，支援多種脈絡更新機制，為長時程智慧體的訓練提供了重要方向。
papers.title: MemOPD: On-Policy Distillation through Memory State Alignment for Long-Horizon Agents
papers.title_zh: MemOPD：透過記憶狀態對齊的隨機策略蒸餾，應用於長時程智慧體

Section 3.4 Table 2: inter-spike retention increases with full attention density across architectures/scales.
Section 3.5: recurrence across Kimi Linear, Qwen3.5, Nemotron-H, and Zamba2 checkpoints from 1.2B to 397B.

As full attention becomes denser, successive PAS become increasingly connected through ISP, ultimately recovering the stable MA morphology of full
papers.summary_zh: 本論文系統性探討分層交錯的混合線性注意力（HLA）大型語言模型（LLM）中，巨量活化（MA）的內部動態。作者發現兩種架構對齊的形態：緊鄰全注意力層之前出現的「注意力前尖峰」（PAS），以及在連續全注意力層間持續的「尖峰間平台」（ISP）。透過涵蓋五種線性注意力架構、六種混合配置及五種資料領域的廣泛推論實驗，證明此現象在各種規模與模型中普遍存在。進一步的受控預訓練實驗顯示，全注意力輸出閘控會顯著衰減其絕對幅度但不消除其層級組織。機制上，作者提出由消除時機所主導的共享系統性離群值生命週期，PAS遵循局部「寫入-匯聚-消除」過程，而ISP對應延遲消除；在全注意力極限下，此觀點可還原全注意力LLM的穩定MA形態。此研究填補HLA LLM內部動力學理解的空白，並提供觀測其層級計算的新視角。

evidence: Section 5.1 Table 3 reports ROA averages of 0.224 for MovieLens/Race and 0.055 for Goodreads/Race, with several near-zero or negative model-level ROA values.

Their relationship is summarized via Representati
papers.summary_zh: 這篇論文提出 FairGap，一個用於聯合評估大型語言模型（LLM）推薦系統公平性的基準測試。傳統公平性審計僅聚焦於可觀察的輸出，但 FairGap 同時衡量「輸出位移」（OBS，基於排名重疊）與「內部位移」（IBS，基於隱藏層表示的餘弦距離），並透過反事實身份探針（性別、年齡、種族）捕捉兩者間的關聯。此方法引入「表徵-輸出對齊」（ROA）分數與四象限診斷，以識別使用者層級的隱藏-輸出不匹配。實驗涵蓋六個開放權重 LLM 家族與三個領域，結果顯示 ROA 極低（多低於 0.22），且存在「隱藏內部偏差」此一輸出審計無法察覺的模式。更關鍵的是，激活引導可將 IBS 降低高達 8 倍，卻同時惡化 OBS，顯示內部與輸出層面的公平性存在根本性的權衡。此研究凸顯僅以輸出為導向的公平性評估在結構上不完整，需採用聯合診斷方法。

links.title: Co-Evolution in Agentic Systems: Toward Self-Directed Evolution Beyond Human Design

evidence: Abstract: describes a survey of co-evolution in agentic systems with a progressive three-stage taxonomy
§2.3 Three-Stage Taxonomy: defines Agent-Agent, Agent-Environment, and Meta Co-Evolution
Limitations: states Meta co-evolution is early-stage and safety/governance are not operationalized
Appendix C: Figure 4 summarizes prior reported results rather than new experiments; within-paper matched comparisons are used
llm_evaluation.rationale: Strong topical relevance to agentic systems, LLM agents, multi-agent self-evolution, and AI safety, though the paper is a qualitative survey rather than an empirical study. It proposes a plausible three-stage taxonomy and distinguishes itself from adjacent surveys, but provides no primary experimental results, baselines, ablations, or quantitative validation. Survey methodology and selection criteria are not sufficiently operationalized for reproduction; limitations are stated but safety and meta co-evolution remain unoperationalized.

primary_link.title: Co-Evolution in Agentic Systems: Toward Self-Directed Evolution Beyond Human Design

papers.summary: Agentic systems are increasingly expected to improve after deployment, yet single-entity self-evolution is often bounded by a static learning context, such as fixed tasks and feedback. This survey focuses on co-evolution in agentic systems, a multi-component form of self-evolution in which multiple agents and their environment impose adaptive pressure on one another. To organize existing papers, we propose a progressive three-stage taxonomy that traces how the system gradually sheds human-engineered constraints. Agent--Agent Co-Evolution studies how agents adapt through dynamic peers, including adversarial, collaborative, and organizational adaptation. Agent--Environment Co-Evolution extends this loop to adaptive tasks, feedback, and interaction spaces that change with the agents. Meta Co-Evolution further explores the possibility of making the evolution mechanism itself evolvable. We also discuss open challenges in evaluating such systems, scaling them across multiple components, and keeping increasingly autonomous evolutionary processes safe and controllable. This survey provides a unified foundation for building robust and open-ended agentic systems that can improve beyond fixed human-designed paths.
papers.summary_zh: 本文針對代理系統（agentic systems）的共同演化（co-evolution）進行了首個系統性回顧，探討多個代理及其環境如何彼此施加適應壓力，形成相互塑形的演化迴路。作者提出一個漸進式的三階段分類架構，依序擴展演化自由的邊界：第一階段為代理與代理的共同演化，涵蓋對抗、合作及組織適應；第二階段將演化延伸至環境，包含任務、回饋與互動空間的共同演化；第三階段則探索演化機制本身的可演化性，邁向開放式演化。作者整理大量文獻，並以跨論文證據圖顯示共同演化在多數設定中能提升效能，但增益會隨演化趨於高原而遞減。文中亦指出動態評測、系統擴展與安全治理等開放挑戰。此調查提供了一個統一基礎，有助於建構能持續改進、超越固定人類設計路徑的強健代理系統。
papers.title: Co-Evolution in Agentic Systems: Toward Self-Directed Evolution Beyond Human Design
papers.title_zh: 代理系統中的共同演化：邁向超越人類設計的自主演化

Rather than storing these traces server-side, providers return them to the client as blocks of encrypted text, which the client passes back with each subsequent request. Building on prior research, we identify an architectural vulnerability: these encrypted blocks are fully compatible and interchangeable across different ses
papers.summary_zh: 本研究揭露大型語言模型 API 的架構漏洞：提供者將推理軌跡加密後回傳用戶端，但這些加密區塊在不同的會話、使用者甚至模型之間均可互通，形成可擴充的解密通道。攻擊者可將受保護旗艦模型（如 Opus 4.8）的加密推理區塊注入較弱且防護較少的同系列模型（如 Haiku 4.5），使其逐字輸出原始推理內容，繞過蒸餾防護。研究亦在公開的代理程式日誌中分析 315,320 個區塊，成功還原個人識別資訊與憑證，顯示隱私外洩與提示注入等進階攻擊風險。作者於揭露後提出以使用者與會話綁定等關鍵密碼學緩解措施，並討論推理軌跡加密與監控的取捨。

evidence: §5.1/Table 1 reports a universal cross-lingual gap of 8.8-18.4 pass@3 points across seven agents.
§6.2/Tables 3-4 report a stratified decomposition of the gap into 55.4% agent, 34.5% translation, 10.1% verifier, with a 6.4% whole-benchmark contamination bound.
§3.3/Appendix C reports judge calibration with κ=0.971 on the English LLM-touched slice and cross-lingual κ from 0.886 (tur) to 0.971 (cmn).

llm_evaluation.rationale: Strongly aligned with agentic LLM evaluation, multilingual/Japanese NLP, and benchmark/judge design. papers.summary_zh: 本研究提出OmnilingualGAIA2，一個將GAIA2代理基準機器翻譯擴展至十種目標語言（涵蓋五種文字系統）的多語言基準，並搭配本地化且經人類校正的驗證器。研究評估七個前沿與開放權重代理，發現跨語言差距普遍存在，幅度約8.8至18.4個pass@3百分點，且與模型規模無關。誤差歸因顯示此差距主要源自模型本身（55%），翻譯缺陷僅佔34.5%，驗證器人為產物佔10.1%。人類語言學分析指出形態線索缺失與歧義放大是非拉丁文字語言失敗的主因。研究強調多語言代理評估應成為全球部署代理的標準報告項目，並提出翻譯管道與驗證器的改進方向。

primary_link.title: FailForge: Distilling Procedural Competence from Persistent Failures into Code Agents

papers.summary: Rejection sampling fine-tuning (RFT) is widely used to train code agents by generating trajectories on verifiable software engineering tasks, retaining those that pass the tests, and fine-tuning on the successful rollouts. However, even strong code agents repeatedly fail on a substantial fraction of such tasks, and standard RFT simply discards these failures. The discarded samples are precisely the hardest and most informative ones, drawn from verifiable instances that are costly to curate. Stro
papers.summary_zh: 本文提出 FailForge 框架，旨在解決拒絕取樣微調（RFT）在軟體工程任務中因持續失敗樣本被丟棄而損失寶貴訓練訊號的問題。標準 RFT 僅保留通過測試的軌跡，但對長期無法解決的困難任務，其失敗軌跡往往隱含可遷移的程序性能力，如故障定位、測試合規檢查與變更傳播等策略。FailForge 針對每個失敗實例，由診斷代理根據失敗軌跡與錯誤輸出歸納出非任務特定的技能，並經洩漏過濾後，將該技能注入教師模型的上下文以引導第二次嘗試。成功軌跡在訓練前會去除技能注入，使學生模型能內化程序性行為而非依賴外部提示。實驗顯示，FailForge 在 SWE-bench Verified 上將 Qwen3.5-4B 的 pass@1 提升 6.6 個百分點，超越額外採樣與實例級提示的基線，且其恢復的軌跡具有更高的每樣本訓練價值，並展現跨儲存庫與跨工具鏈的遷移能力。此方法對於持續失敗的困難任務提供了一種低成本的監督訊號回收途徑，其限制在於需要額外生成技能與過濾成本，且依賴黃金修補程式作為輔助資訊，但整體效率與泛化性仍具優勢。

links.title: Reading is not Reasoning: Bridging the Agentic Policy Gap in Vision-Text Compression

evidence: Abstract: reports CAPS improves over AgentOCR by 5.0% and 3.4% on SearchQA with 3B and 7B backbones, and by 15.6% and 14.5% on full-history ALFWorld.
Diagnosing the Visual-History Policy Gap, Figure 1(b): GRPO raises SearchQA task success while History QA does not improve, indicating the gap is not OCR-only.
Experiments, Table 1: CAPS reaches 39.2 average EM for 3B and 43.5 for 7B on SearchQA.
Experiments, Table 2: CAPS reaches 93.8% and 95.7% success on full-history ALFWorld for 3B and 7B.
Ablation Studies, Table 3: combining offline and online self-distillation outperforms either stage alone.
Appendix D Limitations: renderer choices are not ablated, method depends on successful text-policy trajectories, and the LLM judge introduces model dependence.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Highly relevant to LLM agents, reasoning, and RL-based training; language methodology is central despite the visual-history compression setting. Novelty is moderate: the diagnostic agentic-policy-gap framing is useful, but the proposed two-stage offline/online self-distillation builds on existing GRPO and on-policy distillation methods. Rigor is fairly strong with multi-level diagnostics, ablations, and detailed appendices, but lacks statistical significance testing and relies on an LLM judge. Quantitative evidence supports the main claims, though no error bars are provided. Generalizes across SearchQA/ALFWorld and 3B/7B scales but only one VLM family. Reproducibility is aided by detailed hyperparameters and prompts, but code is only promised for future release.

Vision--text compression reduces these costs by rendering history as images, but the resulting modality shift creates a marked capability gap. Through controlled evaluations of history recovery, matched-state decisions, and complete trajectories, we show that this gap cannot be explained by OCR quality alone. papers.summary_zh: 多步驟語言模型代理在反覆處理日益增長的互動歷史時，會產生高昂的脈絡成本。視覺－文字壓縮（VTC）將歷史渲染為影像以降低成本，但這種模態轉換會造成能力落差。本文透過歷史恢復、匹配狀態決策與完整軌跡的受控評估，證明此落差無法單以 OCR 品質解釋，並稱之為「代理策略鴻溝」。作者提出 CAPS，一個兩階段的跨模態代理策略自我蒸餾框架，利用同一模型較強的純文字歷史策略來監督其視覺歷史對應策略：先以離線軌跡自我蒸餾轉移成功行為，再於強化學習期間進行線上策略自我蒸餾，以密集監督視覺歷史策略所造訪的狀態。在 SearchQA 上，CAPS 相較 AgentOCR 在 3B 與 7B 骨幹上分別提升 5.0% 與 3.4%；在完整歷史 ALFWorld 上則提升 15.6% 與 14.5%，同時平均記憶脈絡成本最多降低 63.3%，尖峰成本最多降低 83.4%。診斷顯示 CAPS 提升行動與查詢的一致性及軌跡品質。此研究強調跨模態策略對齊是有效視覺歷史壓縮的關鍵。限制包括渲染參數未全面消融、依賴教師軌跡品質，且評分使用 LLM 裁判。

links.title: ComboShoppingBench: Evaluating LLM Agents for Budget-Constrained Basket Shopping with Coupons

evidence: Abstract: introduces ComboShoppingBench for budget-constrained basket shopping with coupons and hybrid evaluation combining LLM judges and deterministic validation.
Table 2 (Experiments): reports pass rates across 22 configurations, with GPT-5.5 Think achieving only 61.2% Overall success.
Section 4 Failure Analysis: reports Think improves coupon optimality from 68% to 83% and identifies mutually exclusive coupon selection as a bottleneck.
Appendix G / Table 3: reports LLM evaluator agreement of 97.00-97.57% with an expert-adjudicated human reference over 700 rubric decisions.

llm_evaluation.rationale: Highly relevant to LLM agents, tool use, and benchmark/evaluation, with additional reasoning content. Rigor and evidence are strong, though novelty is benchmark-level rather than methodological and reproducibility is limited by unclear artifact release. Generalizability is moderate due to the simulated single-environment setting.

However, this image-level alignment suffers from referential ambiguity: models struggle to infer the correspondences between multiple visual objects and textual entities from the global representation, leading to data inefficiency and suboptimal semantic grounding. To address this, we propose MultiModal Cod
radar.summary_zh: 這篇論文提出多模態語碼轉換（MMCS），一種新穎的預訓練範式，旨在解決多模態大型語言模型（MLLMs）在影像層級對齊上的指涉模糊性問題。傳統的影像層級對齊，讓模型從全域影像表徵推論多個視覺物件與文字實體之間的對應關係，導致資料效率低落與語意扎根不精確。MMCS 受到語言學上語碼轉換現象的啟發，將文字實體替換為對應的視覺物件，建構交錯的影像-文字序列，迫使模型在生成文字時直接依賴局部視覺特徵，達成顯式的物件層級對齊。作者開發了一套可擴展的資料合成流程，生成包含 773K 筆樣本的預訓練資料集，具備精確的物件-實體對應關係。實驗結果顯示，MMCS 具有極高的資料效率，僅用 50K 筆樣本即可超越以 600K 筆影像-文字配對訓練的模型，並在多種模型規模與視覺編碼器上，於視覺定位與感知基準平均提升 7.9% 與 2.1%。此外，特徵空間分析證實 MMCS 能達成更好的表徵對齊。然而，此方法目前僅聚焦於自然影像中的視覺物件，未來可擴展至圖表理解或場景文字辨識等領域。

links.title: NeuPAT: Neuron-aware Plasticity Allocation Tuning for Language-Preserving MLLMs

evidence: §5.2.1, Tables 1-2: NeuPAT recovers language average to 49.06 vs 43.92 for vanilla tuning, while multimodal average is comparable (61.05 vs 60.98).
§5.2.2, Table 3 and Appendix D.2: Results generalize across Qwen3-0.6B, Phi-4-Mini, Qwen2.5-7B/14B, and Llama3.1-8B.
§5.2.3, Tables 4-6: Ablations compare global update schemes, allocation strategies, and role-specific update constraints.

llm_evaluation.rationale: Strong LLM and multimodal relevance via language-preserving MLLM tuning. primary_link.title: NeuPAT: Neuron-aware Plasticity Allocation Tuning for Language-Preserving MLLMs

radar.summary: Multimodal expansion of large language models (LLMs) enables new perceptual capabilities but often compromises the language intelligence acquired during pretraining. In this work, we investigate this phenomenon from the perspective of internal adaptation dynamics and discover that neurons in pretrained LLMs exhibit heterogeneous plasticity during multimodal learning: some neurons are critical for preserving language capabilities, while others are more adaptive to multimodal knowledge. Based on this insight, we propose NeuPAT (Neuron-aware Plasticity Allocation Tuning), a lightweight and architecture-agnostic framework that allocates neuron-wise update constraints during multimodal instruction tuning. NeuPAT uses a small-scale probing stage to estimate neuron adaptation patterns and selectively protects language-sensitive neurons while promoting multimodal adaptation through more plastic neurons. Experiments across diverse LLM families demonstrate that NeuPAT recovers 94.5\% of the language capability degradation caused by vanilla tuning on 11 language benchmarks while maintaining comparable multimodal performance, providing an effective approach for capability-preserving multimodal expansion.
radar.summary_zh: 本研究探討大型語言模型（LLM）擴展為多模態大型語言模型（MLLM）時，語言智慧受損的問題。作者發現預訓練 LLM 中的神經元在面對文字與視覺輸入時，呈現異質的可塑性：部分神經元對語言能力至關重要，部分則更利於吸收多模態知識。基於此觀察，他們提出 NeuPAT（神經元感知可塑性分配調校）框架，在進行多模態指令調校時，透過輕量探測階段估計神經元對各模態的偏好，並據以動態分配更新限制：保護語言感知神經元、完全更新多模態適應神經元、限制共享神經元的偏離，並利用低反應神經元的額外容量。實驗在 11 個語言基準與 5 個多模態基準上，涵蓋多種 LLM 家族與規模，結果顯示 NeuPAT 能恢復 94.5% 因一般調校導致的語言能力下降，多模態表現幾乎不變，且優於全局凍結、均勻更新、EWC、LoRA、WINGS 等既有方法。消融研究驗證了神經元角色分配與更新策略的有效性。此方法架構無關且不需額外文字資料，為保留語言能力的多模態擴展提供了高效解方；其限制在於尚未驗證於更大規模模型，且目前僅聚焦視覺-語言擴展，未來需探索其他模態與持續學習情境。

primary_link.title: Fisher-R1: Training LLM Agents for Reliable Hypothesis Testing

radar.summary: Reliable hypothesis testing is the foundation of many empirical scientific claims. Large language model (LLM) agents are increasingly used to automate this process, as they can inspect datasets, generate code, and produce analyses end-to-end. However, we show that they frequently make subtle inferential errors that lead to incorrect conclusions despite correctly executed analyses. Existing benchmarks fail to capture this failure mode, as they rarely assess whether a reported p-value is statistic
radar.summary_zh: 本研究指出大型語言模型代理在自動化假設檢定流程中，即使程式碼執行正確，仍常因細微推論錯誤而導致錯誤結論。為填補現有評測基準的不足，作者建構了 P-Bench，一個包含 425 個真實科學資料任務的基準，涵蓋經濟學、生物學與醫學領域，要求代理選擇統計方法、計算 p 值並做出結論，並以專家驗證的標準答案進行評分。為提升可靠性，作者提出 Fisher-R1，透過合成任務與強化學習訓練的開放權重 LLM 代理，獎勵設計兼顧 p 值準確度與結論一致性。實驗結果顯示，Fisher-R1-14B 在多項指標上超越 GPT-5.4 與 DeepSeek-V4-Pro 等強勁基線，在最具挑戰性的任務上單次成功率平均提升約 21%。此研究凸顯目前 LLM 代理在統計推論上的侷限，並示範以驗證結果為獎勵的強化學習可顯著提升其可靠性。作者強調 P-Bench 與 Fisher-R1 應作為評測與監督工具，而非取代人類統計審查，並提醒可靠統計代理也可能為薄弱主張賦予虛假正當性。

primary_link.title: Making Your LLMs More Objective: Stabilizing LLM Safety Behavior Across Traits with Trait-Invariant Safety Tuning

radar.summary: Aligned large language models (LLMs) are expected to exhibit safety behavior based on the content of the user request: they should refuse unsafe requests and comply with safe ones. To measure this failure, we introduce refusal-based metrics: Trait-Induced Deviation measures dataset-level deviation f
radar.summary_zh: 這篇論文探討大型語言模型（LLM）的一個安全性缺陷：當系統提示詞賦予模型不同角色或性格特質時，即使使用者請求不變，模型的安全決策（拒絕或遵從）仍可能大幅變動，此現象稱為特質誘發的安全變異。作者提出拒絕率指標與新指標：特質誘發偏差（TID）衡量整體拒絕率偏離無特質基準的程度，特質誘發翻轉率（TFR）則衡量同一請求在不同特質下決策改變的比例。透過表示層分析，他們發現特質會沿著低維度子空間擾動模型對有害請求的安全表徵。為解決此問題，作者提出特質不變性安全微調（TIST）框架，並實例化為特質子空間中和（TraSN），僅在辨識出的特質子空間內約束模型行為與無特質時一致。實驗顯示TraSN能降低TID與TFR、提升有害請求的拒絕率，同時維持良性請求的合規性與整體能力。局限在於僅涵蓋特定模型與特質組合，且依賴線性表徵與LLM評判。此研究凸顯特質在LLM安全性的重要性，並提供具體緩解方法，有助於提升模型在實際應用中的穩定性與可信度。

primary_link.title: Do LLMs Take Care of Their Own? Similarity Signals Can Induce Cooperation

radar.summary_zh: 這篇論文探討一個新興但關鍵的議題：當大型語言模型（LLM）代理在策略互動中，得知自己與對手的決策過程相似時，是否能促進合作。作者提出了一個評估框架，在各種合作困境（如囚徒困境、公共財遊戲等）中，提供不同程度的相似性分數給模型，並觀察其行為變化。主要發現是，相似性訊號對合作的影響因模型而異，多數模型會隨著相似度提高而增加合作率，但有些模型（如GPT）則不受影響。研究也發現，相似性分數的計算來源（基準測試）對合作影響不大，且模型傾向高估與其他模型的相似性。作者提出了一個行為賽局理論模型，能捕捉LLM在相似性訊號下的推理，並證明在高相似度下，均衡可接近最佳社會福利。此研究對AI代理的安全部署具有重要意義，但也揭示了相似性訊號可能被操縱的風險，需謹慎設計與應用。

llm_evaluation.rationale: Highly relevant LLM/attention architecture paper with careful epistemic labels and machine-checked proof cores, but empirical support is single-group/small-sample and many key claims are conditional or conjectural; novelty is constrained by formalizing previously introduced PLDR-LLM/PLGA.

primary_link.title: Power law graph attention: exact generalization of scaled dot-product attention, empirical collapse at inference

radar.summary: The Large Language Model from Power Law Decoder Representations (PLDR-LLM) and its attention, Power Law Graph Attention (PLGA), replace the fixed bilinear form of scaled dot-product attention (SDPA) with a learned, input-generated bilinear operator G_{LM}, built from a positive tensor A_{LM} by elementwise power laws. The architecture is fully specified, verified against pinned reference releases; claims are labeled theorem, conditional theorem, measurement, or conjecture. Unconditionally: PLGA contains SDPA exactly at G_{LM}=I; A_{LM} and A_P are strictly entrywise positive, with Perron-Frobenius structure on A_{LM}; the DAG regularizer has the NOTEARS walk-counting form and positivity obstructs exact acyclicity; and, under nonresonance (satisfied by standard rotary frequencies), a commutant criterion identifies which operators preserve relative-position dependence. An inference-collapse theorem: exact input invariance of deductive outputs collapses inference to generalized SDPA with a constant operator. Measured invariance: relative fluctuations of 10^{-6} and below; perturbation bounds quantify but do not certify cached inference; the assembled proxy misses the decoding margin. A conditional three-stage mechanism (rotary twirl, concentration, row-map contraction) is measured on a released checkpoint. Blockwise training and scoring under the global Gram are stated with explicit target exposure; on tested samples, block and sequential scoring select identical answers and agree on the published TruthfulQA probability-mass metric within 5times 10^{-5} per item. Self-organized criticality enters as a phenomenological framework with an intrinsic order parameter; open claims become falsifiable conjectures. Selected proof cores are machine-checked in Lean 4.
radar.summary_zh: 本文提出冪律圖注意力（PLGA），將 Transformer 的純量點積注意力（SDPA）推廣為由輸入產生的學習式雙線性算子。作者首先嚴格定義架構，證明 PLGA 在算子為單位矩陣時精確包含 SDPA，並分析其 Perron–Frobenius 結構、DAG 正則化與旋轉位置編碼的換位子特性。核心經驗發現是訓練後的演繹輸出在推論時幾乎與輸入無關，可被快取為常數算子，但此不變性僅為測量假設而非定理；文中給出條件式崩潰定理與擾動界限，並檢驗其是否足以保證解碼位元一致性。作者亦提出自組織臨界性（SOC）作為訓練現象的詮釋架構，將臨界訓練與泛化連結，但強調此僅為現象學框架。本文的價值在於提供 PLGA 的完整數學描述，並明確區分定理、條件式定理與經驗觀察，同時坦言其侷限：不變性機制尚待嚴格推導，且實證僅來自單一研究團隊的少數訓練結果。

radar.summary: Modern critical software infrastructure is largely written in C. Since C lacks memory safety, researchers are investigating automatic translation of C to safer languages like Rust. But real-world C software consists of more than just C code, often using named code fragments called macros which are not part of the C language proper. State-of-the-art techniques avoid translating macros by preprocessing C code first before translating it. But this approach produces translations that are dissimilar
radar.summary_zh: 現代關鍵軟體多以 C 語言撰寫，但 C 缺乏記憶體安全，學界正研究自動翻譯至 Rust 等安全語言。真實 C 程式大量使用巨集（macro），現有工具多先預處理展開巨集再翻譯，導致產出與原始碼差異過大。本文提出第一個具形式規範的巨集翻譯器 MerC，藉由分析巨集與 C 語言共享的語意，制定七條翻譯規則，將巨集轉為 C 的變數、列舉或函式，且不需更動呼叫端。作者亦建立 MacroBench 基準，隨機取樣自 23 個真實 C 程式，含 398 個測試案例。實驗顯示 MerC 成功翻譯 50% 案例且零錯誤，而 GPT-4o、Claude 3.5 Sonnet 與 o1 Preview 等 LLM 雖翻譯更多（22% 至 77%），卻有 8% 至 28% 的錯誤率。關鍵發現是「接棒」策略：先以 MerC 翻譯，再讓 LLM 處理其餘巨集，平均失敗率較純 LLM 降低 32%，翻譯量較純 MerC 增加 51%。此研究凸顯規則與 LLM 互補，可提升翻譯正確性與效率。
radar.title: Translation Tag Team: Formal Rules and LLMs Translate More Macros Together than Apart
radar.title_zh: 翻譯接力賽：形式規則與大型語言模型協同翻譯巨集，勝過各自為政

primary_link.title: Don't `Well, Actually' Me Unless You Know What You're Talking About: Weak Presupposition Verification Degrades General QA Performance

radar.summary: False-presupposition QA (FPQA) tests LLMs on their ability to identify false presuppositions in questions and abstain or correct them rather than reinforcing false assumptions. The common approach reduces the task to prompting LLMs to extract presuppositions and fact checking each presupposition. While the performance on dedicated benchmarks keeps improving, evaluation largely focuses on questions with false presuppositions (FPQs) while ignoring the performance on ``normal'' questions (TPQs). Si
radar.summary_zh: 這篇研究探討大型語言模型在處理帶有錯誤前提的問題時，常用的前提驗證方法雖然提升這類問題的答題表現，卻反而傷害一般問題的回答品質。作者指出，現有基準過度代表錯誤前提問題，忽略真實世界中這類問題僅佔少數，導致方法評估失準。他們在多個模型、基準與檢索設定下發現，表現較佳於錯誤前提問題的方法，通常較差於正常前提問題，形成取捨。進一步分析顯示，主因是事實檢查模組過度拒絕未能證實的前提，即使該前提為真。在估計真實比例後，直接回答的方法整體表現反而較佳。這項發現凸顯事實檢查的瓶頸，對未來開發兼顧兩類問題的穩健方法具有重要啟示。
radar.title: Don't `Well, Actually' Me Unless You Know What You're Talking About: Weak Presupposition Verification Degrades General QA Performance

evidence: Sec 4.1 and Fig.2 (Pages 5-6) report nMSE vs experiment count and pass rates on FORCEBENCH, comparing MDA and LLM baselines with error bars.

primary_link.title: Model Discovery Agent: LLM-assisted Bayesian experiment design for data-efficient discovery of mechanistic world models

radar.summary: Predicting the answer to interventional ``what if'' questions --- the outcome of an action never taken --- requires a \emph{mechanistic}, causal model, not a curve fit; and learning such a model requires \emph{experiments}, because passive data leaves its mechanisms unidentified. We present the Model Discovery Agent (MDA), which couples a large language model (LLM), used as a \emph{proposer} of candidate structures, wit
radar.summary_zh: 本文提出模型發現代理（MDA），結合大型語言模型與貝氏推論、模擬式推論及資訊價值最大化的實驗設計，以資料高效的方式發現潛在的機制性世界模型。MDA在M-open設定下運作，當真實機制不在目前的假設類別中時，會透過預測性檢查觸發假設空間的擴展。作者在三個基準上驗證方法：物理力學（FORCEBENCH）、化學酵素動力學（CHEMBENCH）與新建立的神經元電生理學基準（NEURONBENCH）。結果顯示MDA在資料效率上顯著優於純LLM基準方法，能以較少的實驗次數達到新的最佳表現。作者也探討了隨機延遲動力學的處理，提出使用粒子濾波器與學習式摘要統計量來應付不可解的似然函數。此方法的重要意義在於提供了結合LLM先驗知識與貝氏框架、可進行開放式科學發現的自動化代理。
radar.title: Model Discovery Agent: LLM-assisted Bayesian experiment design for data-efficient discovery of mechanistic world models
radar.title_zh: 模型發現代理：LLM輔助的貝氏實驗設計用於資料高效的機制性世界模型發現

links.title: FaithformBench: Benchmarking Faithfulness of Mathematical Chain-of-Thought Autoformalisation

evidence: Page 5, Section 5.2: 'The perturbations were judged on average as effective in 97.8% of the total 12,784 reasoning steps.'

Page 6, Section 6.1: Figure 3 reports FNR/FPR/AFFR/UFLB for the four specialised AFs; 'Goedel consistently attains the highest FPR' and 'attains this lead despite having the highest FPR, with its advantage driven by its much lower FNR and AFFR.'
Page 7, Limitations: 'Our method does not assess semantic drift in full generality, and is therefore not complete... we recommend that FaithformBench be used as one diagnostic measure among others.'
llm_evaluation.rationale: Highly relevant LLM/CoT evaluation paper: studies faithfulness of autoformalisation systems for mathematical chain-of-thought, with LLM-based perturbation and Lean proof checking to detect error induction and silent correction. Proposes a benchmark, reports quantitative FNR/FPR/AFFR/UFLB, includes human/LLM validation and regex robustness checks, and releases code/data, though it relies partly on LLM judges and explicitly acknowledges incompleteness for semantic drift.

primary_link.title: FaithformBench: Benchmarking Faithfulness of Mathematical Chain-of-Thought Autoformalisation

radar.summary: Autoformalisation (AF) systems map natural language reasoning steps into formal statements in a proof assistant such as Lean. We consider how to assess the faithfulness of these systems. Existing approaches require expensive human-annotated ground truth, or rely on LLM judges or embedding models, which come with limited guarantees of accuracy. In addition, these methods typically only consider inputs that are known to be correct, and therefore do not assess whether the AF translates incorrect in
radar.summary_zh: 本論文提出 FaithformBench 基準，用以評估自動形式化（AF）系統將自然語言推理步驟轉譯為 Lean 形式陳述時的忠實度。有別於仰賴人工標註或 LLM 評判的既有方法，此方法自動產生微擾步驟，使其成為無效推論，並分別衡量「有效性保持」與「無效性保持」，藉此偵測錯誤誘導與靜默修正兩種失敗模式。作者以 ProcessBench 的四個數學資料集為基礎，建構 12,784 組原始與微擾推理步驟，並評估四個微調 AF 模型（Goedel、Herald、Kimina、Stepfun）及四個通用 LLM（Claude Opus 4.7、GPT-5.2、Gemini 3.1 Pro、Qwen Plus）。結果顯示微調模型普遍存在「諂媚」行為，會靜默修正錯誤輸入；且有效性保持能力越佳者，靜默修正傾向也越高。通用模型則表現出較低的靜默修正率。此方法無法偵測語意漂移，且仰賴證明器效能，因此建議作為輔助診斷工具。
radar.title: FaithformBench: Benchmarking Faithfulness of Mathematical Chain-of-Thought Autoformalisation

links.title: How Reasoning Shapes Social Bias in LLM-Generated Code?

evidence: Section 4.1.3 reports average Bias Rate drops from 0.64 to 0.40 with p=0.0117 and Cliff's delta=0.704.
Table 6 reports ProbeDebias reduces average BR from 0.56 to 0.09 while quality is 0.76 vs. 0.77.
Table 5 reports ProbeDebias reasoning-bias detection F1 of 87.76%.
Section 4.2.2 reports GPT-5.1 reasoning-bias labels validated on 216 pairs with 81.94% accuracy and 84.71% F1.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Centrally relevant to LLM reasoning, code generation, and AI safety/fairness. primary_link.title: How Reasoning Shapes Social Bias in LLM-Generated Code?

radar.summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used for code generation, yet generated programs may exhibit social bias through unfair or differential treatment of sensitive demographic attributes. While prior work mainly studies direct code generation, bias in reasoning-based generation remains underexplored. We conduct the first systematic study of social bias in reasoning-based code generation, evaluating 9 standard LLMs and large reasoning models (LRMs) on realistic bias-sensitive tasks acros
radar.summary_zh: 這篇論文首次系統性地研究大型推理模型（LRM）在基於推理的程式碼生成中所展現的社會偏見。作者比較九個標準大型語言模型（LLM）與 LRM，在求職、大學入學與醫療決策等三個敏感場景中，評估推理對程式碼偏見（code bias）的影響。結果顯示，推理平均可將偏見率從 0.64 降至 0.40，但效果因模型而異，且常伴隨程式碼品質下降（平均從 0.72 降至 0.59）。研究進一步發現，有偏見的推理往往導致有偏見的程式碼，而無偏見的推理也不能保證輸出公平；調整生成參數（如推理長度、溫度、敏感屬性位置）對標準 LLM 效果有限且可能損及品質，對 LRM 則影響不大。基於這些發現，作者提出 ProbeDebias，一個在推理階段介入的框架，透過輕量探測器識別有偏見的推理軌跡，並在最終程式碼生成前將其改寫為公平形式。實驗顯示 ProbeDebias 在推理偏見偵測上達到 87.76% 的 F1 分數，並平均減少 83.73% 的程式碼偏見，同時幾乎不損失程式碼品質。此研究凸顯推理階段分析對可信賴程式碼生成的重要性，也為未來緩解程式碼偏見提供新方向。
radar.title: How Reasoning Shapes Social Bias in LLM-Generated Code?
radar.title_zh: 推理如何形塑 LLM 生成程式碼中的社會偏見

links.title: MoRSE: Task-Oriented Multi-Agent System with Mixture of Role-Subtask Experts

evidence: Section 3.2 defines the Mixture of Role-Subtask LoRA Experts with prototype-based semantic router.
Section 3.3 defines hierarchical GRPO with two-layer credit assignment and Proposition 3.1.
Section 4 Experiment reports SRDD and SciCode results across Qwen3-4B, Llama-3.1-8B, and Gemma-4-31B.
Appendix I Implementation Details provides hyperparameters, LoRA rank 8, Ks=4, B=4, M=4, and learning rates.

primary_link.title: MoRSE: Task-Oriented Multi-Agent System with Mixture of Role-Subtask Experts

radar.summary: Large language model-based multi-agent systems have recently shown strong potential for complex, long-horizon tasks. However, existing methods mainly rely on coarse prompt-level differentiation without parameter adaptation for diverse subtasks, resulting in insufficient inter-agent heterogeneity and limited specialized capability that bottleneck performance on tasks with complex requirements. To address this, we introduce a Task-Oriented Multi-Agent System with Mixture of Role-Subtask Experts (M
radar.summary_zh: 本論文提出 MoRSE，旨在解決大型語言模型多代理系統在複雜長期任務中，因僅依賴提示層級角色區分而導致的代理間異質性不足與專精能力受限問題。MoRSE 從任務結構與參數兩個層級同時強化代理特化：首先，透過任務導向的多代理框架，將任務分解為具依賴性的有向無環圖子任務，並為每個代理賦予明確的 (角色, 子任務) 責任。其次，採用動態的 (角色, 子任務) LoRA 專家混合模組，搭配原型式語意路由器，以低成本實現參數層級的特化。為穩定地共同最佳化專家與路由器，作者提出具雙層信用分配的階層式群體相對策略最佳化，隔離專家與路由器的更新，降低梯度變異。實驗於程式碼生成基準上驗證，MoRSE 在整體任務與逐步指標上均優於基線，且學到的特化可泛化至未見任務類別。
radar.title: MoRSE: Task-Oriented Multi-Agent System with Mixture of Role-Subtask Experts

links.title: Social Gym and SPaRTan: Benchmarking and Improving LLM Social Reasoning via Multi-Agent Game Tournaments

evidence: Abstract and Section 3: introduces Social Gym with 21 multi-agent social games and an Elo tournament, plus SPaRTan, a training-free play-reflect-transfer loop.
Section 3.4 and Figure 2: reports per-game and overall Elo/win rate for seven LLMs; GPT-5-mini tops at 1110 Elo, Qwen2.5-3B last at 926.
Table 1 and Section 5.1: GPT-5-mini within-game iterated reflection shows non-monotonic alt-side gains peaking at R3, while main-side tradeoffs vary by game.
Section 5.1 and Figure 3: cross-game transfer shows alt-side injection median +7 pp and main-side negative effects, excluding a saturated Chameleon target.
Section 5.3 and Appendix M: Qwen3-32B replication is largely null except Prisoner's Dilemma and Resistance action-channel setups.

llm_evaluation.rationale: Highly relevant to LLM agents, multi-agent social reasoning, AI-safety-related deception/ToM, and evaluation. primary_link.title: Social Gym and SPaRTan: Benchmarking and Improving LLM Social Reasoning via Multi-Agent Game Tournaments

radar.summary: LLM agents are increasingly deployed in multi-agent social settings where they must cooperate, negotiate, and adapt to other agents. Measuring and improving these social skills is hard because, unlike math or logic, social interaction offers no objective ground truth: evaluations fall back on LLM judges, which are costly, subjective, and noisy, and models get no reliable signal to learn from. To address both, we first introduce Social Gym, an environment of 21 multi-agent social games (e.g., Wer
radar.summary_zh: 本文提出 Social Gym 環境，內含 21 種多代理社交遊戲（如狼人殺、抵抗組織、間諜危機），以規則決定的勝負提供可驗證的評測基準，並以 Elo 錦標賽建立跨遊戲排行榜。實驗顯示 GPT-5-mini 位居榜首，但沒有單一模型在所有遊戲或角色中皆表現優異，凸顯社交推理的多面向性。作者進一步提出 SPaRTan 方法，一種免訓練的自我改善迴圈：模型先進行自我對弈，再反思自身軌跡與結果，產出可遷移的策略手冊，並將其注入後續遊戲的系統提示中。結果顯示 GPT-5-mini 產生的策略手冊能提升不對稱遊戲中較弱勢角色的表現，並可遷移至其他遊戲或較小的模型，但對開放權重模型 Qwen3-32B 的效果有限。此研究提供可重現、可驗證的基礎，以測量與改善 LLM 的社交推理，並為未來結合可驗證獎勵的強化學習鋪路。

links.title: Off-Axis, On Purpose: Where a Transformer Computes Concepts and Why it Does So

evidence: Section 3.1 reports rotating attention values toward the read-out is 64x more damaging than matched random rotation at 10 degrees and 84x at 20 degrees, with asymmetry collapsing to about 1x when cross-token averaging is removed.
Section 3.2 reports orthogonal Procrustes across the commit span yields R^2_rot=0.38, 64% new content, and residual norm growth of 1.74x.
Section 6.2 and Table 4 report dense-device convergence of 7/8 seeds versus 2/8 for the frameless step, with LAMBADA 0.257 and perplexity 19.3.
Section 9.4 explicitly limits the work to a single architecture family, one scale, one corpus, and small seed counts.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Highly relevant to transformer interpretability, attention mechanisms, and language model representation geometry. The paper offers mechanistic measurements of off-axis residual computation and interventions, with matched controls and quantitative results. However, evidence is limited to one GPT-2-class scale, one corpus, and small seed counts; generalizability is explicitly limited, and reproducibility is moderately supported by detailed setup but no code/availability claims.

primary_link.title: Off-Axis, On Purpose: Where a Transformer Computes Concepts and Why it Does So

radar.summary: A transformer's answer lives on one axis: the direction its unembedding reads. Its intermediate states largely do not, and that off-axis position is usually treated as an obstacle to interpretation. We show it is functional. A 12-layer model computes in two phases. Through the first, every sublayer writes into a subspace held near-orthogonal to the read-out, attention 75 to 96 degrees off it at every depth. Moving attention's values onto the read-out is 64 to 84 times more damaging than a matche
radar.summary_zh: 本研究探討 Transformer 模型的中間表徵為何偏離最終詞彙讀出軸，並主張此偏軸位置具有功能性。作者以 GPT-2 small 等級的 12 層模型在 OpenWebText 上訓練，發現注意力層的寫入始終與讀出軸保持約 75 至 96 度的夾角，而這偏軸子空間能隔離跨 token 的混合，避免平均掉詞彙預測；將注意力值旋轉至讀出軸的破壞力是隨機旋轉的 64 至 84 倍，且傷害完全來自跨 token 路徑。模型在最後幾層以加法方式而非旋轉方式寫入答案，且答案約在第 9 層才浮現。作者進一步證明可透過在階段邊界插入固定旋轉來指定此幾何結構，使訓練收斂率從 5/9 提升至 9/9（稀疏旋轉），且不影響下游品質；該框架自由度可自由選擇，甚至可在訓練前指定。研究限制包括單一架構、單一規模與單一語料庫，且收斂率統計僅基於少數種子。此結果顯示部分內部表徵實為自由規範，可被設計而非僅能被發現，對可解釋性研究具有重要意義。

links.title: Reference-Free Post-Training of Open Large Language Models for Multilingual Machine Translation

evidence: Abstract: applies GRPO with reference-free QE reward gated by language identification and SFT-RL checkpoint interpolation.
Section 4.1 Main Results: averaged over scales, WMT24++ XCOMET/COMETKiwi improve by 2.75 and 2.44 points over SFT.
Section 4.2 Analysis: Figure 2 reports interpolation trade-off, with alpha=0.5 recovering 2.79-4.21 spBLEU at different scales.
Section 5 On-Policy Distillation Analysis: OPD approaches but does not surpass RL+interpolation, with Table 2 comparing students.
Appendix C: reports complete GRPO hyperparameters shared across scales.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Directly relevant to LLM post-training, RLHF/GRPO, and multilingual MT, with broad multilingual benchmarking. Novelty is incremental given prior GRPO/QE-based MT work, though checkpoint interpolation and OPD analysis add useful evidence. Rigor is solid with baselines, ablations, and detailed appendices, but evaluation partly relies on the same learned quality metrics used as rewards, and no human or significance testing is reported.

primary_link.title: Reference-Free Post-Training of Open Large Language Models for Multilingual Machine Translation

top5.summary: We study reference-free post-training for multilingual machine translation with open large language models. Starting from the supervised-finetuned MiLMMT-46-v0.1 models, we apply Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) with a reward that averages two reference-free quality estimation models and is gated by language identification. We then linearly interpolate the supervised fine-tuning (SFT) and reinforcement learning (RL) model checkpoints to obtain MiLMMT-46-v1.0. Across 46 languages, the resulting models consistently improve translation quality over their SFT counterparts, outperform strong recent open baselines, including Seed-X, HY-MT2, and TranslateGemma, and achieve leading reference-free scores against evaluated proprietary systems such as Google Translate, Gemini 3 Pro, and GPT-5. We further investigate on-policy distillation and find that it reaches, but does not surpass, the quality frontier achieved by RL with checkpoint interpolation. We release the models and code to facilitate future research.
top5.summary_zh: 本研究探討開放大型語言模型在「無參考」條件下的後訓練方法，以期提升多語機器翻譯品質。研究以 XCOMET 與 COMETKiwi 兩種品質評估模型之平均分數作為獎勵，並以語言識別加以過濾，透過 GRPO 進行強化學習，再將監督式微調與強化學習的模型參數進行線性內插，取得 MiLMMT-46-v1.0。在 46 種語言、三種模型規模的實驗中，此方法一致地超越監督式微調模型，並在多項指標上優於 Google Translate、Gemini 3 Pro、GPT-5 等專屬系統，以及 Seed-X、HY-MT2、TranslateGemma 等開放模型。此外，研究也探討「同策略蒸餾」（OPD），結果顯示其可逼近但未能超越強化學習加內插的品質水準。此研究提出了一套可擴展、無需參考譯文的後訓練流程，有助於提升開放多語翻譯模型的效能。
